title: Multi-Systemic Therapy Team Supervisor
description:
We are looking for an experienced and motivated leader to join our Children's Services team as a Multisystemic Therapy Team Supervisor.


**What is Multisystemic Therapy (MST)?**


Multisystemic Therapy (MST) is an intensive, evidence\-based intervention for children and young people aged 10\-17 who are at risk of entering care, custody or other out\-of\-home placements. MST works with the whole system around a young person, including their family, school, peer group and wider community, to understand and address the factors contributing to difficulties.


MST is based on many years of research into what works with families and uses evidence\-based approaches including behavioural therapy, cognitive behavioural therapy and structured family therapy.


MST takes an ecological approach, recognising that a young person's behaviour is influenced by interconnected systems including their family, peers, school and wider community. Therapists work intensively with families in their homes and communities, empowering parents and carers to become the primary agents of change and helping families build the skills, confidence and support networks needed to achieve lasting positive outcomes.


**Previous MST qualifications are not required.**


Successful candidates will receive comprehensive training in the licensed MST model, together with ongoing coaching, supervision, consultation and fidelity support from an MST consultant.


This role provides a unique opportunity to develop therapeutic and systemic practice skills within internationally recognised, evidence\-based interventions.


**About us**


At Cheshire East Council we are resident, and partner focused with a vision to enable prosperity and wellbeing for all. People really are at the heart of everything we do and that starts with our incredible workforce. We promote a culture of high performance where people can aspire, thrive and flourish, where we strive to deliver best value in everything we do.


For us, success isn’t just about what we achieve, but how we achieve it together. We promote curiosity, excellence, innovation and continuous improvement.


We are values led and committed to wellbeing and inclusion for all, where our employees co\-created our values of drive, integrity, respect and collaboration which inform all that we do.


We are proud to work for Cheshire East Council and believe you would be too!


**Join us on a meaningful journey in Children’s Social Care at Cheshire East Council**


We’re on a meaningful journey in Children’s Social Care and we’d love for you to be part of it. Joining us means becoming part of a supportive, forward\-thinking team that’s passionate about making a real difference in the lives of children and young people. Everything we do is about putting them first, helping them grow, thrive and reach their full potential so they can build brighter futures.


If this sounds like the kind of impact you want to make, we’d be delighted to hear from you. Come and join us in shaping positive change for our young people.


**About the role:**


The post holder will contribute to and participate in arrangements that provide 24\-hour, 7\-day\-a\-week support for children, young people, families and practitioners involved in MST. This will include providing clinical advice and support to practitioners during periods of on\-call cover and helping to ensure continuity of support and safe service delivery outside normal working hours. The frequency and operation of the on\-call rota will be determined by team arrangements and Council policies.


**Key responsibilities include:**


* Leading and supervising a team of practitioners to deliver high\-quality interventions in line with the MST model.
* Providing clinical oversight, risk management and safeguarding leadership across all cases.
* Supporting complex decision\-making and ensuring positive outcomes for children, young people and families.
* Building effective relationships with Social Care, Early Help, Family Help and other key partners to coordinate support.
* Driving service quality, performance, learning and continuous improvement through supervision, audit and outcome monitoring.

You will be a confident leader with strong safeguarding knowledge, excellent judgement and the ability to support and develop others in delivering high\-quality practice.

* Strong knowledge of safeguarding, risk management, child development and family functioning.
* The ability to make sound decisions, manage competing priorities and provide clear professional guidance.
* A commitment to strengths\-based, trauma\-informed and anti\-discriminatory practice.
* Excellent communication and partnership\-working skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across services.

title: Functional Family Therapy Practitioner
description:
Join our dedicated Children's Services team and help make a lasting difference to the lives of children and families across Cheshire East as a Functional Family Therapy Practitioner


**What is Functional Family Therapy Child Welfare (FFT\-CW)?**


Functional Family Therapy Child Welfare (FFT\-CW) is an evidence\-based therapeutic intervention that will be delivered in Cheshire East for children aged 0\-9 and their families who are at risk of care entry due to significant child welfare concerns. FFT\-CW works with children, parents, carers and wider family networks to strengthen relationships, improve communication, enhance parenting approaches and reduce the factors placing children at risk.


The model combines structured family\-based therapeutic intervention with practical support, helping families build on their strengths and develop the skills, confidence and resilience needed to achieve lasting change. FFT\-CW can support families experiencing challenges such as family conflict, emotional wellbeing concerns, trauma, anxiety, substance misuse and difficulties within family relationships.


FFT is an internationally recognised model delivered to thousands of families each year and is supported by ongoing research, training and clinical oversight to ensure high\-quality, evidence\-based practice.


**Previous FFT\-CW qualifications are not required.**

title: R&D Tax Technical Manager/Associate Director
description:
**Our Purpose**

We are financial consultants to entrepreneurs providing expertise in accountancy solutions and commercial business advisory services. Our name, derived from the adjective ‘sedulous’, epitomises the work ethic, commitment and attention to detail we perform on each project to ensure the highest possible level of service. We offer a full range of services from the inception of the business concept, throughout growth of the entity and on to exit strategies. There is no typical clientele; we operate on new start businesses to multinational stock listed companies.

**The Role**

We are seeking an R\&D Tax Manager to Associate Director to lead our team of consultants in the North West, helping innovative companies across the region identify and secure Research \& Development tax incentives.

Leading from the front on a varied portfolio of innovative businesses, you will manage and develop a team of R\&D consultants while working directly with founders, technical leads and senior stakeholders to assess complex projects against UK R\&D tax legislation. The role combines hands\-on technical delivery with genuine leadership: setting standards, reviewing output and shaping how the team grows.

This is an opportunity for a technically minded leader to take ownership of a growing regional practice, with a clear route to Associate Director and beyond.

* Lead and develop a team of R\&D tax consultants in the North West, setting the standard for quality, compliance and client care.
* Oversee a portfolio of claims spanning a broad range of sectors, from software and engineering through to manufacturing and life sciences.
* Conduct and review technical discussions and interviews with client stakeholders to identify qualifying R\&D activities.
* Review technical narratives and supporting documentation to ensure claims are robust, compliant and clearly evidenced against HMRC R\&D legislation.
* Oversee the compilation and review of qualifying R\&D expenditure and supporting financial schedules.
* Act as the senior point of contact for claim submissions and HMRC enquiries, supporting the team through responses where required.
* Build lasting client relationships and identify opportunities to grow the practice across the North.
* Coach, mentor and develop consultants, giving clear feedback and supporting their technical and career progression.
* This is a client\-facing role. You will spend meaningful time with the businesses you support, building genuine relationships rather than running a transactional process.
* Lead kick\-off meetings and technical interviews with client stakeholders
* Translate complex technical and scientific information into clear, HMRC\-compliant narratives
* Act as a trusted point of contact throughout the claims process, keeping clients informed at every stage
* Identify opportunities to add further value across Sedulo's wider service offerin

**What We Are Looking for:**

You will come from a technology or technical background rather than a finance one. We are open on sector, what matters most is curiosity, commercial awareness, and a commitment to doing things properly:

* Degree in a technology, engineering, science or other technical discipline, we are open on the specific field.
* Significant experience preparing and reviewing R\&D tax relief claims, with a track record of managing your own portfolio.
* Confidence engaging with technical teams across a wide range of technologies and sectors, and the ability to get to grips with new subject matter quickly.
* Experience leading, mentoring or managing consultants, with the ability to raise standards and bring people with you.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear written documentation.
* Strong commercial awareness and the ability to balance multiple client engagements alongside team priorities.
* Ambition to progress to Associate Director and help shape a growing regional practice.

**What we offer**

We’re committed to supporting our people both professionally and personally. Our benefits are designed to help you thrive inside and outside of work:

* 26 days’ holiday per year (including your birthday as a paid day off), plus all public bank holidays and two paid volunteering days.
* Flexible \& Hybrid Working: Enjoy flexible working hours with core hours between 10am and 4pm, and the option to work remotely for up to 20% of your working week. You can also work abroad for up to one month per year and flex up to 2 of your UK bank holidays to suit your personal beliefs or preferences.
* Financial Security \& Support: Pension scheme with Royal London, plus free access to financial and mortgage advice, life insurance cover, and income protection from day one.
* Health \& Wellbeing: Access a range of discounted health, wellbeing, and retail benefits to help you stay healthy and make the most of your downtime through Help@Hand, Medicash and Zest.
* Learning \& Development: Continuous professional and personal development opportunities to support your career growth.
* Culture \& Community: Enjoy access to our exclusive members’ club facilities, including complimentary breakfast and refreshments, regular social and networking events, and our legendary annual Christmas conference.
* Family\-Friendly Policies: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave with additional family friendly policies to support you.
* Travel \& Lifestyle Perks: Annual travel ticket loan, Cycle to Work Scheme, and access to our salary sacrifice Electric Vehicle scheme through Octopus EV.

*Sedulo Group requests that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by our People \& Culture Director.* 

*Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised. We will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.* 

*In the event that an uninstructed agency's correspondence includes a disclaimer indicating otherwise, our policy will prevail.*

-----------------

### **Job summary**

**Please note this role requires you to pass** **Security Check** **clearance. For further information, please see 'Selection process details'.**

**Do you have excellent problem\-solving skills, a keen eye for detail, and experience of working with complex data sets?**


Digital Workspaces provides technical infrastructure, used directly by Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) colleagues and citizens, and by other Digital services. It does this through seven main Product areas, one of which is Workplace Computing.


The Workplace Computing team own a complex set of infrastructure Products. We are responsible for providing, building, deploying, tracking, managing, and disposing of laptops, peripherals, and printers for approximately 125k Civil Servants, OGDs, contractors, and suppliers. The volume and complexity of that operation is significant, relying heavily on a mix of in\-house expertise and an extensive supply chain.


This is an excellent opportunity to be part of the Workplace Computing IT Asset Management Team (ITAM), responsible for circa 125k devices throughout their lifecycle. You'll play a key role in ensuring IT assets are accurately recorded, tracked, and managed via the ITAM Lifecycle, from acquisition through to disposal, helping DWP maintain a reliable and effective technology service for colleagues across the organisation.


Through effective management of asset data and processes, you will help ensure DWP colleagues have the technology they need to deliver vital services to the public across the network.

### **Job description**


As an IT Asset Manager, you will develop and implement IT Hardware Asset Management plans and procedures.


This will entail agreeing the scope of plans and procedures with stakeholders and ensuring that changes to plans and procedures are properly assessed for impact and communicated.


You will identify, track, control, audit, and report on IT Hardware Assets and associated data in accordance with the defined plans, procedures, and schedules.


You will produce management reporting on areas of non\-compliance.


You will monitor Hardware Asset Management (HAM) procedures to ensure that they are fit for purpose and evaluate existing IT Asset Management systems, instigating improvement actions as required.


You will work closely with a range of stakeholders, including Digital colleagues, suppliers and operational teams, using data and insight to support decision\-making, improve processes and ensure DWP's technology assets are effectively managed, controlled and compliant throughout their lifecycle.


You will assure and maintain tools in support of Hardware Asset Management processes and report on the status of IT asset management processes and data. This will include providing management information on process effectiveness.

**Please note:** Whilenot essential and you will **not** be assessed against this, it would be desirable for you to hold a foundation ITIL certification. There will be an opportunity for you to achieve this qualification while in the role, if successful.

### **Person specification**


See selection process for further details.


If you would like to learn more about the role, please contact Natalie.Selby1@dwp.gov.uk.

### **Technical skills**


We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:


* Asset \& Configuration Management
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £44,447, Department for Work and Pensions contributes £12,876 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
We also have a broad benefits package built around your work\-life balance which includes:

* Working patterns to support work/life balance such as job sharing, term\-time working, flexi\-time and compressed hours.
* Generous annual leave  at least 25 days on entry, increasing up to 30 days over time (prorata for part time employees), plus 9 days public and privilege leave.
* Support for financial wellbeing, including interest\-free season ticket loans for travel, a cycle to work scheme and an employee discount scheme.

* Funded learning and development to support progress in your role and career. This includes industry recognised qualifications and accreditations, coaching, mentoring and talent development programmes.
* An inclusive and diverse environment with opportunities to join professional and interpersonal networks including Womens Network, National Race Network, National Disability Network (THRIVE) and many more.

**Hybrid Working**


This role may be suitable for hybrid working, which is where an employee works part of the week in their DWP office and part of the week from home. This is a voluntary, non\-contractual arrangement and your office will be your contractual place of work.


If a hybrid working arrangement is suitable for the role and for you, you will normally be required to spend a minimum of 60% of your contracted working hours from your DWP office.


If you have a disability, caring responsibilities, or other circumstances that may affect your ability to meet the minimum office attendance requirement, please discuss this with us using the contact details in this advert.

**Salary Information**


New entrants to the Civil Service will join on band minimum.


Existing Civil Servants who secure a new role on lateral transfer will maintain their current substantive salary.


Existing Civil Servants who gain promotion will move to the bottom of the grade pay scale or receive a 10% increase applied to their current substantive salary, whichever is greater.


Any temporary allowances that you are currently in receipt of will not form part of the calculation to determine your pay. Any allowances that are in payment will cease when you move into your new role.

**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.### **Selection process details**


This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Experience and Technical skills.**Stage 1: Application**
  

  

Your application will consist of four parts:
  

  

1\. A Personal Details application form.
  

  

2\. Employment history \- this should contain your work experience and any skills, qualifications and accomplishments relevant to the jobs you have completed.

* Demonstrative ability to interpret complex IT Hardware Asset information and present in a simplified format to peers and management.
* Experience of agreeing the scope of IT Hardware Asset Management standards, plans, processes and procedures with stakeholders to optimise the capture and use of asset management data.
* Proven experience of managing IT Hardware Assets and ensuring that changes are properly impacted and communicated.
* Experience of evaluating existing IT Hardware Asset management systems and leading the continuous improvement of IT Asset Management procedures.

* Experience of developing and applying processes, techniques and tools to capture, track, correct and report on IT Hardware Assets and associated data to ensure for accuracy and completeness.


Ensure that all examples provided in your statements are taken directly from your own experience and that you describe the examples in your own words. If you choose to use gen\-AI to support your statements, you must follow the guidelines outlined in the **Artificial intelligence and recruitment guide.**

description:
**Job Title**
-------------

  

* Providing holistic financial planning advice to existing NFU Mutual customers
  
* Partnering with local Agencies of NFU Mutual and developing relationships with their customers
  
* Field based with frequent travel to include a select combination of the following areas; Cheshire and Shropshire regions
  
**About the role**
------------------


NFU Mutual is growing, and as a Financial Advisor you’ll be at the heart of this growth, providing advice for life insurance, pensions, investments, wealth management and inheritance tax to a broad range of customers.

  

Why is this important to you? Well, as a Financial Advisor, you’ll work closely with specific Agencies in the NFU Mutual Agency Network in Cheshire, Shropshire and the wider area. . Each agency has an average of 2,500 customers and agency staff who’ll work to deliver a full diary just for you. Your drive, vision and personal ambition are the only limit to your future earning potential.

  

You’ll develop strong customer relationships from warm leads, with a range of customers from small investors to high net worth individuals. You’ll also continue our tradition of providing excellent personal service by getting to know each customers’ circumstances and helping to protect them, their families and businesses.

  

As a mutual, we’re owned by our customers, so it’s vital we always do the right thing for them. That’s why we’re proud of our impressive 95% policy renewal rate and high customer satisfaction scores. These results show how much our customers across the UK appreciate our approach.

**About you**
-------------


We’re looking for people like you. People dedicated to delivering the best financial outcomes for clients. You’re competitive, someone who loves to exceed expectations, both ours and our customers. You’re driven to be the best at what you do.

  

An expert at building trusting relationships, you’ll easily work with a panel of NFU Mutual Agents to offer advice on a range of NFU Mutual products across Life, Pensions and Investments to both new and existing customers.

  

We are keen to speak with candidates with the following skills and experience;

  

* Fully FPC (or equivalent) qualified plus full CAS, full QCA Level 4 qualification (e.g. CII Diploma in Financial Planning)
  
* Experience of delivering regulated financial advice to UK customers, face to face with a proven track record of financial results
  
* Strong knowledge and understanding of the UK financial services regulatory and compliance framework
  
* Good knowledge of end\-to\-end sales processes, preferably with experience of working with introducers
  
* Knowledge of developments in the UK financial services industry
  
* Full UK driving licence

  

This is a field based role requiring multi\-site travel up to 4 days per week to Agents of NFU Mutual, customers and NFU Mutual offices.

 **Certification**  

*This role is subject to certification. Certification applies to key roles within the organisation that meet set criteria defined by our regulators.*

 **Certified Function**  

This role is subject to certification for MSIL due to being identified as:

 **Function Requiring Qualification**  

*A person carrying out a role that requires a regulatory qualification as defined within the FCA Training \& Competence (T\&C) Sourcebook.*

 **Client Dealing, previously CF30**  

*A person who performs the client\-dealing certification function which involves any of the following; advising on investments and performing other functions related to this such as dealing and arranging.*

  

NFU Mutual support an inclusive workplace and value all the differences that make us unique. We celebrate the creativity and innovation that comes from diverse perspectives and experiences and share a common vision of doing the right thing for our customers and employees.

  

We recognise that some candidates may experience barriers during the recruitment process. So, we encourage candidates to discuss any adjustments or accommodations they need to be the best they can be throughout our recruitment process.

  

We're proud to be a Disability Confident Employer, a Race at Work and Women in Finance Charter signatory and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, ethnicity, disability, neurodiversity, gender, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, or socioeconomic background.

**Benefits and Rewards**
------------------------


When you join our team, you can expect a supportive culture and an attractive range of rewards and benefits including:

  

* Basic salary range starting from £50,000 \+
  
* Uncapped commission scheme
  
* Company car scheme
  
* Annual bonus (up to 5% of salary)
  
* Contributory pension scheme, up to 20%, including your 8% contribution
  
* 25 days annual leave \+ bank holidays \+ buy/sell/save holiday trading scheme
  
* A Family Friendly policy that helps you balance your work and family responsibilities
  
* Access to savings at High Street brands, travel and supermarkets
  
* £20 contribution to a monthly gym membership – subject to T\&Cs
  
* Health and wellbeing plan \- cashback for dentist, opticians, physio and more
  
* Access to voluntary benefits, including health assessments, private medical insurance and dental insurance
  
* Employee Volunteering \- volunteer in the community for one day each year
  
* Unlimited access to Refer a Friend £500 bonus scheme
  
* Life Assurance cover of 4 x salary
  
* Employee discounts of 15% on a range of NFU Mutual insurance policies.
  
* Salary sacrifice employee car scheme \- subject to eligibility
  
**Working at NFU Mutual**
-------------------------


We’re one of the UK’s leading general insurance and financial services organisations, and for over 110 years we’ve put our customers at the heart of everything we do. Our people are just as important to us, so we’re proud to be recognised as “a great place to work”.

  

Our Gallup Exceptional Workplace 2026 award was not only awarded with Distinction, but it also marked us as the first UK based company to earn a Gallup Exceptional Workplace award for eleven consecutive years. We’ve also been consistently recognised by Glassdoor. We appeared in the Glassdoor Best Places to Work UK list in 2023, 2024 and 2026 — and in 2026, we were the highest ranked insurance business in the UK, highlighting our strong employee experience and the positive feedback our people share on the platform.

  

Additionally, we were named in the LinkedIn Top Companies 2026 list of “Best midsize employers to grow your career in the UK”, and we’ve been certified as a UK Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute in 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\.  

We offer a supportive and empowering culture where people are inspired to perform, given opportunities to grow, and recognised and rewarded for their contribution. Our people are proud to work for a company that respects them and their communities, and they trust us to be financially sustainable—so we’re successful now and in the future.

### **Basic information**

Location
Manchester
Business Line

### **Job description**

**Connect to your Industry**


Join a team of leading tax professionals in the fast\-paced and challenging world of Corporate Tax.


The tax landscape is a constantly changing working environment; with changes to tax legislation, increased media focus and scrutiny, technology advancements, and the increasingly global reach of clients, all coming together to shape an exciting and challenging future in the market for tax services. And our team is at the forefront of that future. Deloitte’s corporation tax team has a market leading reputation; bringing together a unique blend of consulting, technology, tax technical and tax reporting experience to help businesses meet the challenges of multi\-jurisdictional tax operations, including compliance, reporting, tax technology and tax risk management.


Joining the team will give you the opportunity to develop strong relationships with senior tax and finance leaders across a range of industries, helping them address their tax management challenges. We can offer a genuinely varied role where you can balance your time on clients in the areas where you want to develop your career. This includes opportunities in tax compliance, tax reporting, tax advisory, transactions and tax audit services.

**Connect to your career at Deloitte**


Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.


What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we **lead the way**, **serve with integrity**, **take care of each other**, **foster inclusion**, and **collaborate for measurable impact**. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.

**Connect to your opportunity**

You will use commercial awareness and technical knowledge, along with leveraging the skills and expertise of colleagues from across our Business Tax practice, to deliver the best possible experience and outcomes for our clients in tax compliance and advisory projects.


You will have the opportunity to be a people manager and a coach, with development of the team at the heart of the role. You will be a confident team player and enjoy sharing your knowledge and expertise with others, as well as continuing to build your own technical expertise or specialism.


A role within the Business Tax team will involve:

* Acting as the main contact for your client portfolio – building deep trusted client relationships and being responsible for quality, delivery and all aspects of client service on the engagement;
* Using your knowledge of your clients’ businesses to help bring tax advisory solutions – taking a leading role in delivering these advisory projects and working with our specialist teams (e.g. transfer pricing);
* Working with overseas member firms to deliver high quality tax solutions to large multinational organisations;
* Applying your understanding of how the evolving international tax landscape impacts large multinational organisations (e.g. Pillar II legislation);
* Developing an understanding our your clients’ tax data and technologies, and building your experience of our tax management consulting advisory services, to identify and help deliver improvements to your clients’ tax compliance and reporting processes, technologies and governance – offering a holistic solution;
* Having the opportunity to work on the tax audits of major multinationals, identifying and resolving material tax technical issues and reviewing the accuracy of tax reporting;
* Mentoring more junior members of the team, playing an active role in their development;
* Working across a range of industries (including Financial Services, Consumer Business, Energy \& Resources, Technology, Media and Telecommunications); and
* Managing diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

**Connect to your skills and professional experience**

Our people are talented, outgoing and flexible individuals who are confident working side by side with senior personnel to become trusted business advisors. They have deep experience in their corporate tax technical specialism but are able to adapt to the ever\-evolving world at the leading edge of tax management consultancy.


To qualify for the role you should be/have:

* ACA/CTA or equivalent qualification or experience;
* Experience of advising on transactions, both from a diligence and structuring perspective;
* Previous tax experience gained in industry or a professional services firm;
* Day to day management of a portfolio of clients;
* Relationship management with key UK and International contacts;
* Managing a team of individuals to deliver tax services to a varied portfolio of clients;
* Delivery and management of tax advisory projects, potentially including international restructuring and refinancing, transfer pricing and M\&A projects;
* Managing and overseeing compliance and advisory projects, with regards to managing client and statutory deadlines, billing requirements and delegating effectively to both UK and overseas teams;
* Dealing with HM Revenue and Customs on technical matters; and
* Excellent communication and project management skills.

**Connect to your business – Tax**


Innovation and tax consultancy may not seem to go together, but that’s exactly what you’ll find at Deloitte. We’re constantly seeking the new and working together to push the limits of what’s possible. Discover a new kind of tax career that you can make your own.


**Tax**

Our comprehensive range of services encompasses everything from the completion of tax returns (corporation tax self\-assessment) to complex consultancy assignments and strategic tax planning. We advise on corporate and general tax, international M\&A, stamp tax, cross\-border transfer pricing, reorganisations and reconstructions, and competent authority negotiations.

**Personal independence**

Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints (e.g., in relation to any financial interests and employment relationships). This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm, and also prohibitions on certain employment relationships (e.g., you are not permitted to hold a secondary employment role with SEC audit clients of the firm whilst being employed by the firm). The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process or you can contact the Independence team upon request.

**Connect with your colleagues**

“We advise some of the largest, most prestigious clients in the world, so the work is really challenging and exciting. We also have a fantastic team of smart, driven people, and a supportive, entrepreneurial culture where everyone’s encouraged to be bold, creative, and ambitious.”\- Oliver, Tax

**Our hybrid working policy**


You’ll be based in Manchester with hybrid working.


At Deloitte we understand the importance of balancing your career alongside your home life. That’s why we’ll support you to work flexibly through our hybrid working policy. Depending on the requirements of your role, you’ll have the opportunity to work in your local office, virtual collaboration spaces, client sites and remotely. You’ll get the chance to meet face to face when needed, while you collaborate and learn from colleagues, share your experiences, and build the relationships that will fuel your career and prioritise your wellbeing. Please check with your recruiter for the specific working requirements that may apply for your role.

**Our commitment to you**

Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.


We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective and personality. So we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.


Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world\-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.

**Connect to your next step**

A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.


Discover more reasons to connect with us, our people and purpose\-driven culture at deloitte.co.uk/careers

**DISCOVER YOUR POTENTIAL. BUILD YOUR CAREER. JOIN US AT AAB.**  

AAB is a leading professional services firm operating across the UK, Ireland, and the USA. We specialise in the mid\-market, supporting individuals, family businesses, and organisations with a full suite of services including audit, tax, corporate finance, payroll, people consultancy, and wealth management. With 1,000\+ team members, we deliver expert support to clients all over the world.  

**EVERYONE HAS THE AABILITY TO SUCCEED\- WE’LL HELP YOU GET THERE.**  

Our people are at the heart of everything we do. We succeed together as one team, building strong client relationships through passion, empathy, and straightforward advice. That’s what makes AAB different. We invest in brilliant talent across every area of the business, offering tailored training, professional qualifications, and continuous support to help you grow.  

Your growth matters to us. We’ll give you the tools, encouragement, and opportunities to lead, learn, and make an impact. Guided by our six core values, we foster a culture where collaboration, trust, and enthusiasm thrive.  

  

**AABSOLUTELY DEDICATED TO HELPING YOU ACHIEVE YOUR GOALS**  

  

At AAB, your career is what you make it. We are here to help you turn ambition into action, whether that’s becoming a technical expert, a future leader, or someone who simply makes a difference every day. If you're ready to be part of a team that’s united by purpose and driven by values, we’d love to hear from you.  

**ESG COMMITMENT**  

We take our responsibility seriously. From reducing our environmental impact, to supporting education through training and talent programmes, to giving back to our local communities with our charitable initiative ABBIE\- ESG is part of who we are.  

### **ROLE PURPOSE**

  

Key duties \& responsibilities:* Lead the review of significant advisory engagements, ensuring quality, consistency and adherence to risk management procedures.
* Take overall responsibility for managing a portfolio of indirect tax clients, acting as a trusted advisor and senior point of contact.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, identifying opportunities to add value and expand service offerings.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across indirect tax compliance and advisory processes, enhancing efficiency and client experience.
* Oversee the allocation and delivery of work across the team, managing resource planning and ensuring deadlines and utilisation targets are met.
* Provide technical leadership on complex VAT and indirect tax matters, supporting the team in resolving issues and delivering robust solutions.
* Lead the review of compliance and advisory work, ensuring quality, consistency and adherence to risk management procedures.
* Take ownership of significant advisory projects and client engagements, delivering commercially focused advice and practical recommendations.
* Support clients with VAT structuring, transactions, risk mitigation, HMRC enquiries and complex technical matters.
* Monitor developments in legislation, HMRC policy and case law, assessing the impact on clients and proactively identifying advisory opportunities.
* Work closely with Directors and Partners to develop and execute business development plans and strategic growth initiatives.
* Lead the preparation of proposals, tenders and presentations, contributing to the winning of new business and strengthening client relationships.
* Represent the firm at client meetings, networking events, seminars and industry forums, promoting the firm's indirect tax capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-selling and collaborating with other service lines across the business.
* Lead, mentor and develop Managers, Assistant Managers and junior team members, fostering technical excellence and supporting career progression.
* Support the leadership team in achieving financial, operational and strategic objectives for the service line.
* Contribute to the development of the firm's indirect tax strategy and support the implementation of key business initiatives.
* Actively contribute to the growth of the indirect tax practice through business development, networking, thought leadership and market\-facing activity.
* Identify opportunities within the existing client base and wider market to expand the firm's indirect tax advisory services.
* Develop strong referral networks internally and externally to generate new advisory opportunities.
* Support the development of strategic sector propositions and targeted growth initiatives.

  

### **Experience \& qualifications**

  

* Extensive experience within indirect tax, with a strong focus on advisory services and delivering commercially focused solutions to clients.
* Proven experience operating at Manager or Senior Manager level within a professional services environment.
* Strong technical knowledge of VAT and indirect tax legislation, with the ability to provide practical, commercially focused advice.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex client portfolios and leading high\-value client relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to identify, develop and convert advisory opportunities, contributing to revenue growth and the development of client relationships.
* Strong business development skills with a track record of identifying opportunities and contributing to revenue growth.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing teams, including coaching, mentoring and performance management.
* Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of the wider professional services market.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
* CTA qualified, ACA/ACCA qualified or equivalent professional qualification preferred.

  

### **WHAT AAB OFFER**

  

We want you to feel supported inside and outside of work. That’s why we offer a benefits package designed for your wellbeing, lifestyle, and career.  

Time Off \& Family Support* Annual leave (plus public holidays), with the option to buy or carry over leave
* Enhanced parental leave (maternity, paternity, adoption)
* Paid volunteering day to support causes that matter to you

Health \& Wellbeing* Private Medical Insurance (PMI) for you and the option to cover family members
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for 24/7 mental health and wellbeing support
* Death in Service benefit

Financial Security* Competitive pension scheme
* Life assurance policies to support you and your family

Flexible \& Agile Working* Hybrid working model
* Agile working culture that supports flexible hours and smarter working
* Modern office spaces designed for collaboration, focus, and wellbeing

  

***Disclaimer***  

*Unsolicited CVs sent to AAB by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this position. AAB operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our recruitment partners.*  

### **About AAB**

As a **Tax Specialist** you will be working directly with the Tax Manager on all tax\-related matters within the Group. You will be providing assistance with day\-to\-day queries, managing tax cash flows, delivering cross\-tax compliance, supporting the maintenance and management of the Group’s tax policies, procedures and documentation, assisting with Research and Development Claims and Capital Allowances claims and supporting the delivery of project\-based tax advice.


This role will involve supporting the Tax Manager, the Group Finance Director and other stakeholders to ensure compliance with UK tax laws and regulations. This includes supporting the Group Financial Director and Chief Financial Officer under the SAO regime.


This is a great role for a Tax Senior/Assistant Manager seeking their first move into an in\-house industry role, who already has 3\-5 years UK Tax experience and is looking to develop further in\-house. The Tax team is a close\-knit team, forming part of an award\-winning wider Finance Team in a thriving and successful business.


As a **Tax Specialist** we are looking for someone to:

* Support the Tax Manager with all aspects of corporation tax compliance, including preparation, review, and filing of tax returns.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively liaise with internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office products
* Strong focus on the quality of work with attention to detail

### **Job summary**

**Would you like to build a career in IT Asset Management, learning how technology assets are managed throughout their lifecycle while supporting services that make a real difference to people's lives?**

**Do you want to build a rewarding career in IT, gaining practical experience in a live support environment while working towards a recognised qualification?**


Join Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) Digital and become part of a highly motivated team that supports the reliability of critical digital services used by millions of people every day. No two days are the same, and you'll have the opportunity to learn while contributing to services that help people access benefits, employment support and State Pension information.


This is a fantastic opportunity to earn while you learn, combining hands\-on experience with a Level 3 Digital Support Technician Apprenticeship. You'll spend your time not only developing the knowledge, skills and behaviours required to complete your qualification, but also applying what you learn directly within your role, building practical experience that will support your long\-term career development.


We are committed to helping you succeed. You'll be given dedicated off the job training time within your working hours to complete your apprenticeship studies, ensuring you can balance learning with your day to day responsibilities. Alongside support from your line manager and experienced colleagues, you'll have a strong network around you to help you grow, develop and achieve your qualification.


If you're enthusiastic, curious and ready to embrace new challenges, this apprenticeship offers the perfect opportunity to learn, contribute and build a successful career in digital services.

**Please note: As part of the role, occasional travel to other DWP Digital hubs may be required.**

### **Job description**


Your work as an Apprentice IT Asset Manager will involve different aspects subject to changing business priorities, therefore we need people who are adaptable and flexible.


As an Apprentice IT Asset Manager, this is an exciting opportunity to earn as you learn and get hands on practice while you study towards a Level 3 Digital Support Technician qualification.


Youll receive formal learning to develop crucial skills, knowledge and behaviours for your career and be part of a great team. Upon completion of the required learning and practical experience, you will:

* Learn and follow established IT Asset Management processes, procedures and controls for managing software and hardware assets.
* Develop your understanding of how technology assets are identified, tracked, controlled and reported across a large organisation.
* Support the management of lower\-risk software publishers, helping to review renewals and ensure value for money is achieved.
* Use industry\-standard tools and techniques to capture, maintain and report on asset information and associated data.
* Support the creation and maintenance of asset management baselines in line with agreed processes and standards.
* Build effective working relationships with stakeholders and help manage their expectations.
* Carry out routine maintenance and housekeeping activities to ensure asset data remains accurate and up to date.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of IT Asset Management processes and services.
* Learn how to identify risks and issues, escalating them appropriately when required.


You will be supported by your line manager, skills coach, fellow apprentices, DWP Apprenticeship Team and the wider Digital and Transformation Directorate. You will have access to a variety of sources of encouragement to help you succeed. There is a lot to learn and do, so you need to be proactive, work hard and participate in the many opportunities you will be given to showcase your skills. If you wish to find out more about the Level 3 Digital Support Technician Apprenticeship, please click here


The L3 Digital Support Technician Apprenticeship is expected to take up to 15 months to complete, however the full learning journey for this role will take up to 18 months. You will be given time out from your role to work on your apprenticeship. You must be committed to seeing through the apprenticeship and completing the qualification within the appropriate time period.

**Please Note: Successful appointments to this role will be subject to completion of the apprenticeship programme. Failure to comply or failure to achieve the required apprenticeship may be dealt with under disciplinary or poor performance procedures and may lead to termination of the employment contract or exceptionally, redeployment into another DWP role.**


To be eligible for this appointment and the apprenticeship funding, there are a number of eligibility criteria set out by the Department for Work and Pensions. Full details can be found at Apprenticeship funding rules: 2026 to 2027\.


Candidates should ensure that they can meet these before applying. Some key points are listed below:

* Have the right to live and work in the UK valid for the full 18 month duration of the apprenticeship and associated learning journey.
* Must have lived in the UK and/or EEA for 3 years prior to apprenticeship start date or hold some form of exemption (Apprenticeship funding rules 2026 to 2027\)
* Not be in full\-time education or be already undertaking another apprenticeship by the apprenticeship start date.
* If you are 16 or 17 you are required to stay in full time education or training until you are 18  commencing this apprenticeship will allow you to meet this requirement.
* Apprentices aged 16 to 18 at the start of their apprenticeship, that do not already hold a relevant English or Maths qualification, will still be required to complete the appropriate functional skills qualifications to pass their apprenticeship.
* You must not hold an existing qualification at the same or higher level in a similar subject to the apprenticeship. A qualification in a non\-related subject would be acceptable. Eligibility will be confirmed by our nominated training provider.
* You must not already have significant previous work experience covering the knowledge, skills and behaviours demonstrated in the apprenticeship standard identified above.
* If you have already worked in a similar field, you should consider applying for other vacancies that do not require you to complete the apprenticeship, as too much relevant experience will make you ineligible and we would need to withdraw the offer in these circumstances.

**Please list your qualifications in the qualification section. Failure to meet any of the eligibility criteria or not listing your qualifications may result in you being withdrawn.**


We expect the apprenticeship to start from early 2027\. Please ensure that you are available from this date.

Join a team that makes a real difference. Our Reablement Service empowers people to rebuild their skills, confidence, and independence and supporting people to achieve what matters most to them.


As a key leader within the service, you will play a pivotal role in delivering Cheshire East Council's Prevent, Reduce, Enable (PRE) Programme, helping people to remain independent for longer, reducing reliance on long\-term services and enabling individuals to achieve the outcomes that matter most to them.


This is an exciting time to join us as we continue our journey of transformation and modernisation. As Resource Manager, you will provide both strategic and operational leadership across a dispersed workforce, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective and high\-quality Reablement services. You will lead teams across multiple locations, driving performance, quality, workforce development and continuous improvement.


A key aspect of the role will be supporting the development and delivery of integrated working arrangements with health partners, contributing to seamless pathways that support people to regain and maintain their independence.


You will be responsible for analysing and interpreting service performance data, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement, supporting service planning and ensuring resources are effectively deployed to meet demand. Through your leadership, you will champion the PRE principles, embedding strengths\-based, outcome\-focused practice throughout the service.


**As Resource Manager, you will:**

**The Role**
------------


**The team..**


The Accounts Payable team operates at the heart of our Finance Operations hub, managing payment obligations to our suppliers. We are a data\-driven, detail\-oriented, and highly collaborative function focused on driving automation, process compliance, and continuous improvement across the Order to Cash and Procure to Pay lifecycles. Working closely with Purchasing Support, Master Data, Tax, and our Global Process Owner, we take pride in delivering accurate, right\-first\-time processing and building strong, trusted relationships with suppliers globally.


**The role..**


We’re looking for an Accounts Payable Processing Assistant to join our team on a permanent basis. Reporting directly to the Accounts Payable Manager, your core purpose will be to manage the company’s payment obligations to suppliers by ensuring the accurate and timely input and exception handling of invoices.


This is a dynamic, high\-volume role with a strong focus on date\-sensitive entries (e.g., invoice dates, due dates, payment dates, and values). Beyond day\-to\-day transactional processing within our SLAs, you will be a curious problem solver who investigates the root causes of invoice automation failures, analyses generic trends, and implements continuous improvements alongside our Global Process Owner to stop recurring errors.


Some of your key day\-to\-day responsibilities will include:


* Reviewing and verifying invoice details against purchase orders with a special focus on date\-sensitive entries before system input, ensuring compliance with company policies, tax, and legal requirements.
* Investigating root causes for invoices that fail processing automation and implementing remediation steps to prevent future failures.
* Analysing large volumes of data to identify generic trends that improve system recognition success, working closely with suppliers and the Global Process Owner.
* Processing invoices within SLAs to prepare for weekly payment runs and month\-end activities.
* Providing factual data and trend analysis to the Accounts Payable Ledger and Compliance teams to drive Purchase Order (PO) compliance and right\-first\-time processing.
* Building strong supplier relationships to improve invoice receipt timelines versus payment on time, analysing rejected invoices, and educating vendors on invoice requirements.
* Collaborating with the Tax team to enhance tax input accuracy and eliminate the need for manual invoice corrections.
* Updating and monitoring team KPIs, maintaining Standard Operating Processing (SOP) notes, and making proactive recommendations to boost performance.
* Supporting the onboarding and training of new team members through active knowledge sharing.

**Skills you’ll need** (minimum criteria)


* Significant experience working within an Accounts Payable team with a solid practical understanding of accounting principles and AP workflows.
* Experience with accounting software (e.g., Oracle, SAP) and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Proven proficiency in Optical Character Recognition systems (e.g., IDR, Kofax).
* Demonstrated strong competency in problem solving, analytical thinking, and high attention to detail when managing high\-volume data.
* Basic understanding of tax reporting requirements related to supplier processing.
* Ability to manage time effectively, prioritise tasks, and meet strict deadlines.

**Other things we’re looking for** (key criteria)


* Experience working with Finance ERPs (specifically Oracle Fusion) and specialised AP workflow automation tools.
* Preferred experience working within a fast\-paced Shared Service Center environment.
* Knowledge of multi\-currency transactions and international vendor handling.
* Excellent communication skills to present root\-cause findings, explain trend analysis, and share process improvement suggestions.
* A continuous improvement mindset, curiosity, risk and fraud awareness, and the ability to adapt to meet stretched targets.

*Please note, on occasion we may receive a very large volume of applications which means applications for a role may close earlier than the referenced closing date. We’d encourage you to apply as soon as possible if interested.*

description:
**Job Title:** Branch Manager – Professional House Share \& Corporate Lets (Bolton, Walkden \& Salford)

**Department:** Mistoria House Share – Professional HMO, Bedsit and Corporate Lettings

**Entity:** Mistoria House Share Ltd, part of The Mistoria Group

**Reporting to:**

* Chief Executive Officer

**Direct Reports:** Assistant Branch Manager, Lettings \& Property Managers, Lettings Negotiators, Maintenance Staff

**Role Summary:**

The **Branch Manager – Professional House Share \& Corporate Lets** is a senior leadership role accountable for the performance of the Bolton, Walkden and Salford operation and a portfolio of approximately **250 tenancies**, covering professional house shares, bedsit and non\-self\-contained HMO units, studios, and corporate and contractor lets. The role involves working closely with the **Chief Executive Officer**, driving occupancy, rental performance, portfolio growth and full regulatory compliance across a fast\-moving, year\-round letting operation with no academic season to fall back on.

The ideal candidate is **commercially driven, compliance\-focused, and experienced in HMO and corporate lettings management**, with a strong understanding of **bills\-inclusive letting economics, tenant relations, and current lettings legislation**.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Professional House Share, Bedsit \& HMO Lettings**

* Own the end\-to\-end letting cycle for approximately **250 tenancies** across Bolton, Walkden and Salford, re\-marketing every room immediately on notice to minimise voids.
* Manage individual room lets, non\-self\-contained bedsit units, studios and whole\-property lets, applying the correct **tenancy structure** to each.
* Oversee applications, **ID and Right to Rent checks**, affordability referencing, guarantor arrangements and deposit handling in line with Group controlled procedures.
* Apply the post\-**Renters’ Rights Act 2025** framework correctly, using only the Group’s controlled Assured Periodic Tenancy templates.

**2\. Corporate Lets, Contractor \& Relocation Business**

* Develop **corporate and contractor letting income** by building direct relationships with employers, contractors, relocation agents and serviced accommodation operators.
* Ensure all corporate let documentation is **Legal and Compliance\-approved** before issue, and escalate any unclear company\-let arrangement to the Legal and Compliance Manager.
* Apply a **documented risk assessment** before entering any corporate, contractor or rent\-to\-rent arrangement.
* Maintain a live schedule of corporate and rent\-to\-rent contracts and **report it monthly** to the CEO and Finance Director.

**3\. Marketing, Occupancy \& Enquiry Conversion**

* Sustain a minimum of **97% occupancy** across the managed portfolio, minimising void periods.
* Ensure every room is marketed on **Rightmove, SpareRoom, Zoopla and the Mistoria House Share website** within 48 hours of becoming available, with high\-quality photography and floorplans.
* Ensure every enquiry is responded to within **one working day** and monitor conversion from enquiry to viewing to signed tenancy.
* Achieve and sustain **market or above\-market rents**, applying the Section 13 rent increase process correctly.

**4\. Bills\-Inclusive Utilities \& Council Tax Control**

* Take direct responsibility for the **profitability of bills\-inclusive lettings**, setting and reviewing inclusive rents against actual consumption.
* Operate the Group’s bills\-inclusive utilities procedure, including accurate **meter readings**, correct account set\-up and void liability identification.
* Manage **council tax exposure** across the portfolio, claiming all exemptions and discounts and challenging incorrect banding.
* Report utility and council tax cost against inclusive rent income **monthly**.

**5\. Void, Arrears \& Inspection Control**

* Maintain and review a **live void schedule** daily, reporting it weekly to the CEO.
* Monitor **rent arrears** daily and manage them through the Group’s staged arrears process, escalating to Legal and Compliance before any possession action.
* Inspect every property **at least once every two months**, recording each inspection with dated photographic evidence.
* Apply the elevated inspection discipline required for **bedsit and non\-self\-contained accommodation**, including fire safety checks.

**6\. Compliance \& Regulatory Standards**

* Maintain full compliance across **HMO, additional and selective licensing, planning and Article 4 position, gas, electrical, EPC/MEES and fire safety**.
* Ensure no property, room or unit is **marketed or let** unless the property file supports that decision.
* Operate in accordance with the **Renters’ Rights Act 2025, Awaab’s Law, the HHSRS and the Homes (Fitness for Human Habitation) Act 2018**.
* Conduct regular property audits and enforce accuracy of documentation and system records (**Concurrent, PayProp, TouchRight**).

**7\. Growth, Leadership \& CEO Reporting**

* Identify opportunities for **landlord acquisition, corporate client development and portfolio growth**, targeting a minimum 10% net increase in managed units per financial year.
* Lead, manage and develop the **branch and lettings teams** across Bolton, Walkden and Salford, implementing training, KPIs and appraisal frameworks.
* Deliver a service standard resulting in **no unresolved complaints** escalating to The Property Ombudsman.
* Provide a **formal weekly report to the CEO** covering occupancy, rental performance, marketing, arrears, inspections, compliance, staff performance and growth KPIs.

**Job Specification:**

**Education \& Experience:**

* Proven experience managing a **professional house share, HMO or lettings portfolio** at branch or senior level.
* Strong track record of **business development, landlord acquisition and corporate client development**.
* Experience managing **corporate, contractor and rent\-to\-rent letting arrangements**.

**Technical Skills:**

* Confident use of **Concurrent, PayProp, TouchRight, Rightmove, SpareRoom and Zoopla**, or directly comparable platforms.
* Working knowledge of **AI tools** (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) for reporting, KPI dashboards and process automation.
* Thorough working knowledge of **HMO licensing, planning/Article 4, tenancy law and the Renters’ Rights Act 2025 framework**.

**Personal Attributes:**

* Results\-focused, with strong **commercial acumen** and attention to detail.
* Resilient and adaptable, able to lead a team in a **fast\-paced, changing environment**.
* Proactive and strategic, with sound judgement on **when to escalate** a legal, licensing or contractual question.
* Strong **leadership, negotiation and relationship\-management** skills.

**Liaison Relationships:**

**Internal:**

* **Chief Executive Officer** – Daily contact on occupancy, marketing and conversion; formal weekly reporting.
* **Finance Director** – Reporting on corporate/rent\-to\-rent contract position and corporate credit control.
* **Legal \& Compliance Manager** – Escalation of possession, licensing, corporate let and tenancy queries.
* **Head of Renovations and RFM** – Coordinating refurbishment and reconfiguration to lift rent, unit count or letting speed.
* **Branch team** (Assistant Branch Manager, Lettings \& Property Managers, Lettings Negotiators, Maintenance Staff) – Day\-to\-day leadership and performance management.

**External:**

* **Landlords** – Property performance, compliance and growth.
* **Tenants** – Tenancy management, complaints and renewals.
* **Corporate clients \& relocation agents** – Business development and account management.
* **Local councils \& compliance inspectors** – HMO licensing, planning and inspection compliance.

**Performance Indicators \& Targets:**

* **Occupancy:** Minimum 97% sustained across the managed portfolio; voids re\-let within 21 days.
* **Rental Performance:** Market rent or above achieved on 95%\+ of properties, rooms and units.
* **Enquiry Conversion:** Every enquiry responded to within one working day; conversion tracked weekly.
* **Bills\-Inclusive Margin:** No property carried at a negative inclusive margin without an approved action plan.
* **Property Inspections:** 100% of properties inspected at least every two months, with dated photographic evidence.
* **Rent Arrears:** Arrears held within agreed tolerance; staged arrears process evidenced on every case.
* **Portfolio Growth:** Minimum 10% net increase in landlord acquisition and property onboarding per financial year.
* **Compliance:** Zero avoidable breaches across safety, legal, planning and licensing obligations.
* **Complaints:** No unresolved landlord, tenant or corporate client complaints on a rolling six\-month basis.

The duties and responsibilities of this role may change without prior notice, and the company reserves the right to modify or assign other duties as necessary to meet business requirements.

**Overview of the job**


This is a management role within the National Probation Service (NPS).

**Summary**


The jobholder will manage the efficient and effective operation of the AP. They will supervise AP staff to ensure compliance with NPS strategy for use of AP. They will create and maintain a safe environment ensuring the safety of staff, residents, the public and the premises. They will offer support and cover to other teams/functions during periods of absence.


In line with NPS policies and procedures, the job holder must at all times demonstrate a commitment to equality and inclusion and an understanding of their relevance to the work they do.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**About Q Smart**

Q Smart is a rapidly growing renewable energy business specialising in heat pump distribution, design, MCS compliance and installer support.

With annual turnover approaching £6 million and a trajectory of growth within the next 12 months of £7–£10 million, we are looking for an experienced, hands\-on Finance Manager to take ownership of our internal finance function and help build the financial processes and controls needed for the next stage of our growth.

This is a senior part\-time position of 25 hours a week, offering genuine responsibility, autonomy and a flexible five\-day working pattern that can accommodate school\-friendly hours.

**The Role**

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, you will take day\-to\-day ownership of Q Smart’s finance function.

You will ensure our financial records are accurate and fully reconciled, produce timely management information, maintain oversight of cash flow and working capital, and ensure strong financial controls are in place across the business.

You will supervise and support our existing accounts payable team member while taking direct responsibility for management accounts, accounts receivable, credit control, cash\-flow forecasting and financial reporting.

Our statutory accounts, corporation tax return and specialist tax advice will continue to be handled by our external accountant. You will ensure the business remains year\-end ready and act as their main finance contact.

**Key Responsibilities \- Management Accounts and Reporting**

* Produce accurate monthly management accounts, including P\&L, balance sheet and cash\-flow reporting.
* Complete the monthly finance close to an agreed timetable.
* Provide clear commentary on performance, variances, risks and opportunities.
* Maintain a rolling 13\-week cash\-flow forecast.
* Support budgeting and financial forecasting.
* Produce useful profitability and commercial analysis for the Managing Director.

**Cash, Credit Control and Working Capital**

* Maintain oversight of the company's daily cash position and upcoming commitments.
* Take ownership of accounts receivable and the sales ledger.
* Proactively manage aged debt and credit control.
* Review customer credit limits, payment terms and new credit\-account applications.
* Escalate outstanding debts and recommend appropriate recovery action.
* Review and prepare supplier payment runs.

**Financial Control and Compliance**

* Maintain a fully reconciled balance sheet each month.
* Ensure bank, VAT, payroll, pension, debtor, creditor and other control accounts are accurately reconciled.
* Maintain appropriate accruals, prepayments and supporting schedules.
* Prepare, review and submit VAT returns.
* Coordinate and review payroll, pensions and employee expenses.
* Maintain clear audit trails and appropriate financial controls.

**Accounts Payable**

* Supervise and support the existing accounts payable employee.
* Review supplier reconciliations, aged creditors and payment commitments.
* Ensure appropriate purchasing, invoice approval and supplier controls are maintained.

**Year\-End and External Accountancy**

* Keep the accounting records in a year\-end\-ready position throughout the year.
* Prepare year\-end schedules, reconciliations and supporting information.
* Provide a complete and organised year\-end file to the external accountant.
* Act as the main point of contact for accounting queries and ensure year\-end adjustments are correctly recorded.

**Processes and Improvement**

* Review and improve existing finance processes and controls.
* Establish clear procedures and approval levels across purchasing, payments, invoicing, credit control and customer accounts.
* Identify and improve the quality and timeliness of financial information across the business.
* Help develop the finance systems and controls required to support growth toward £10 million turnover.

**About You**

We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking genuine ownership of an SME finance function while remaining hands\-on with the detail.

**You will ideally have:**

* Previous experience as a Finance Manager, Company Accountant, Management Accountant or Financial Controller.
* Experience within an owner\-managed SME or similarly fast\-moving business.
* Proven experience producing complete monthly management accounts.
* Strong knowledge of balance\-sheet reconciliations, VAT, accruals and prepayments.
* Experience managing accounts receivable, credit control and accounts payable.
* Experience preparing cash\-flow forecasts and management reporting.
* A good understanding of payroll and associated reconciliations.
* Strong Excel and accounting software skills.
* The confidence to work independently and directly with the Managing Director.
* A practical, commercial approach and willingness to remain hands\-on.

Experience within SME, stock or project\-based businesses would be advantageous but is not essential.

**Qualifications**

We are open\-minded about professional qualifications.

You may be:

* AAT qualified;
* ACCA or CIMA part\-qualified;
* Fully qualified; or
* Qualified by experience.

Practical SME finance experience, commercial judgement and the ability to take ownership are more important to us than a particular qualification.

**What We Offer**

* £54,000–£60,000 full\-time equivalent salary.
* An autonomous position with genuine responsibility.
* 25 hours per week across five days.
* Flexible, and school\-friendly working hours.
* Company pension.
* Supportive, entrepreneurial working environment.
* Direct involvement with the Managing Director.
* The opportunity to shape and improve the finance function of a growing £6m\+ business.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV together with a short covering note outlining your relevant SME finance experience, current availability and preferred working hours.

Pay: £33,750\.00\-£37,500\.00 per year

Benefits:

* On\-site parking
