title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
**Talent Acquisition Lead**


Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) \| £60,000 \- £70,000


Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns *how* we hire, not just who we hire.


We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset. Skilled at your craft \- able to land the hardest hires yourself, but also understanding what will make a whole team better at hiring \- from candidate attraction to relationship building; employer brand to candidate experience.

**Why this role exists now**
----------------------------


Our recruiting team is strong but stacked \- and as we get busier, there’s no real capacity to ensure we’re constantly innovating and improving the mechanisms that let us hire quality people at pace. We’ve recently raised investment, and have ambitious goals to achieve \- now is the time to fine\-tune our recruiting engine so we can scale effectively over the next few years.

**The role**
------------


This is a role of two halves. The first half is hands\-on delivery. IC L5s at Street Group are expected to confidently own the hardest searches \- senior roles, niche roles, brand new roles we’ve no experience hiring for. You’ll be expected to understand how the roles you’re hiring for tie in to commercial goals, what to prioritise and why. When you run into issues, you investigate, gather qualitative and quantitative data, conduct market research, and ultimately develop solutions to solve your own problems. You share your knowledge with the team in ways that bring them on the journey \- not just the “what and how” but the strong “why” behind it.


The second half is taking our TA function from great to exceptional. Candidate experience, employer brand, AI, tooling, sourcing strategy, assessment \- we do all of them well already, but our team holds ourselves to a high standard \- and we want to do it all *exceptionally* well. You’ll collaborate with our Head of People on the most impactful initiatives to prioritise \- the what, why, why now, and how it will be achieved and measured. We expect you to be passionate about TA; part of communities, intrigued by industry trends, new tools, best practices, and what other companies are nailing (and making sure we do it even better).

**Growth opportunities**
------------------------


The business and People team will grow significantly over the next few years, and there is potential for this role to grow into a management role or specialise in a specific area, but the initial focus and goals will be hands\-on, IC L5 work as mentioned above.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

* A senior recruiter with deep expertise across the full lifecycle, and the outside\-in view: what the market's doing, what great TA teams do, and what it means for us.
* Someone who holds themselves to a high standard \- e.g. measuring their results against quality of hire rather than hires made.
* Someone whose judgement colleagues calibrate against, trusted with delivering the most senior and confidential searches without a steer.
* An AI\-native mindset: you treat AI as leverage and are keen to learn from our team, and share what’s been working for you.
* The credibility and communication skills to challenge a department head on a bad hiring decision, deliver hard market news to leadership, and come out with the relationship stronger.
* Someone who makes the team better on purpose, not by accident: you share what you know and help develop the people around you.

**Why you might** ***not*** **want to apply**
---------------------------------------------


We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.

* **If you want to move into people management now.** This is a senior IC role. You'll coach, share knowledge, and set standards, but you won't have direct reports on day one, and you'll still be carrying reqs yourself. If a management title is what you're chasing now or in the imminent future, this isn’t the job for you.
* **If you're a brilliant solo recruiter but you don't have a history of lifting up the people around you.** This role will impact how our entire TA function operates, and evidence of knowledge sharing from prior roles will be assessed during the interview process.
* **If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool.** We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company\-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.
* **If you tend to report the problems you’re facing in searches.** We need someone who spots the funnel stage quietly losing good candidates, or the hiring plan the market won't support, and fixes it before anyone flags it. At IC L5, we don’t expect your manager to be the one flagging problems or coming up with solutions for you.
* **If you like to just crack on with recruitment.** Connect with us and join the Talent MCR meetup \- we’d love to connect \- but this role will be expected to do more than just deliver.

If that list sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!

*We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!*

**Who are Street Group?**
-------------------------


We’re an award\-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom \& Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.


Our products form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.


Back in 2015, our co\-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1\.0\. He’d seen first\-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. **Spectre** is now our multi\-award\-winning instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%.

**Street.co.uk** then launched back in 2020 and serves as our game\-changing CRM, allowing agents to deliver a service that aligns seamlessly with the modern, 'on\-demand' needs of customers and their busy lifestyles.

**Why join Street Group?**
--------------------------


Hybrid\-working \- you can work from home up to 4 days per week  

Guilt\-Free R\&R \- £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)  

Structured career growth and ongoing professional development  

£500 yearly L\&D budget
  

Your birthday on us \- we pay, you stay away  

‘Give something back’ \- 2 paid days volunteering on us  

Enhanced maternity, paternity \& adoption pay  

Mental health \& well\-being support via Health Assured  

Regular well\-being initiatives  

Public transport season ticket loans  

Paid menopause leave  

Holiday buying scheme  

Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition  

Be a part of something bigger \- everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day  

A chance to work on cutting\-edge technology  

Comfortable, relaxed office space \- office dogs welcome!  

Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon  

Company and team off\-sites, events and happy hours  

Cycle to work scheme  

Electric car salary sacrifice scheme  

Feel good about sustainability \- we're a climate\-positive company!

**Salary**
----------


£60,000 \- £70,000, depending on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

  

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

  

**Interview Process**
---------------------


3 stages \= 60\-minute video call with our Head of People \> In\-person interview with two members of the People team \> Final interview with two members of our SLT.


We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

  

**A note on using AI in your job application**
----------------------------------------------


As a fast\-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you \- your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI\-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

**How we use AI in the hiring process**
---------------------------------------


Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by humans \- not AI. Let us know if you have any questions!

As Academies Financial Reporting Manager, you will lead a team of specialist finance professionals responsible for consolidating and reporting financial information across the academies sector. You will play a key role in delivering the Academies Sector Annual Report and Accounts (SARA), Whole of Government Accounts returns, Estimates processes and other statutory reporting requirements.
  
  

As a Academies Financial Reporting Manager your main responsibilities will be:
  
  

* Lead the production and delivery of the Academies Sector Annual Report and Accounts (SARA), ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards and HM Treasury guidance.
* Produce high\-quality consolidated financial reporting to support Parliamentary and government decision\-making.
* Manage relationships with key stakeholders including HM Treasury, the National Audit Office and senior departmental leaders.
* Lead, motivate and develop a high\-performing reporting and outturn team.
* Manage reporting timetables and ensure all statutory and Parliamentary deadlines are achieved.
* Lead engagement with auditors, supporting audit activity and resolution of findings.
* Provide expert advice on accounting treatments, disclosures and financial reporting matters affecting the academies sector.
* Drive continuous improvement of financial reporting processes, controls and data quality.
* Analyse financial performance, emerging risks and trends across the academies sector.
* Provide strategic financial advice on funding, policy and accounting developments


**Essential:**  

* Qualified Accountant status (CCAB or CIMA) or significant equivalent government finance experience.
* Extensive experience supporting or leading audits with a strong record of successful delivery.
* Strong financial accounting expertise, including reconciliation of complex financial information, ensuring accuracy and resolving discrepancies.
* Experience delivering complex financial reporting, public expenditure or statutory reporting exercises to challenging deadlines.
* Advanced Excel skills with the ability to analyse and interpret large, complex datasets.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to explain complex accounting treatments, findings and processes to a range of technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Desirable:**  

* Experience of project management and continuous improvement initiatives, particularly relating to digital services.


Please be aware that this role can only be worked within the UK and not Overseas.

* Oversee quarterly and annual VAT returns, tax compliance, statutory reporting, and act as the primary point of contact for external accountants and auditors

We're looking for an Accounts Receivable lead who will be responsible for overseeing the Accounts Receivable Team within our Shared Services Organisation. The role ensures the effective management of the company’s AR processes, including the timely collection of outstanding debts, the accurate and timely posting of cash and the management and development of the AR Team.


The AR Lead will conduct regular 121s, performance reviews, and other associated people processes, providing leadership and guidance as well as developing and implementing best practices to improve results, efficiency, and effectiveness within the AR process.


Relationships will be key in this role and there will be an expectation to attend stakeholder meetings and work with the various Business units to ensure that a high level of service is provided to our clients.


**Main Duties:**


* Lead, coach and develop a hybrid team comprising three UK Market Collectors, one Ireland Market Collector, one Cash Allocation Clerk and one Customer and Vendor Master Data Clerk, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, objective setting, development discussions and team meetings.
* Act as a hands\-on leader, providing operational support and cover during annual leave, absence and peak workload periods to ensure service continuity across Collections, Cash Allocation and Master Data activities.
* Manage team resources, workload allocation, wellbeing and hybrid working arrangements to maintain high levels of performance, engagement and customer service.
* Lead collection activities across the UK and Ireland customer portfolios, ensuring cash collection, overdue debt and DSO targets are achieved.
* Act as the senior escalation point for complex disputes, payment issues, high\-risk accounts, payment plans and customer negotiations, working closely with Sales, Commercial, Operations and Customer Service teams to resolve issues and improve customer outcomes.
* Own legal recovery and insolvency activities, including management of debt collection agencies, solicitors and insolvency practitioners, whilst overseeing claims, proof of debt submissions, recoveries, bad debt exposure and write\-off recommendations.
* Oversee the timely and accurate allocation of customer receipts, ensuring unapplied cash is minimised and allocation controls are maintained.
* Oversee customer and vendor master data processes, ensuring data integrity, appropriate approvals, compliance with internal controls and segregation of duties.
* Own the weekly, monthly and ad hoc OTC reporting cycle, ensuring all reports are accurate, quality checked, distributed on time and accompanied by meaningful commentary, analysis, risks and recommended actions.
* Present performance trends, risks, opportunities and corrective actions to the Transactional Finance Manager and other key stakeholders.
* Maintain effective financial controls, documented procedures and audit readiness across the OTC function.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for standardisation, automation, process simplification and operational efficiency.
* Support wider Shared Services, Finance transformation and business change initiatives, together with any other duties appropriate to the role.
  
**What you bring**
------------------


Key Competencies and Skills:


* Proven leadership experience within Order\-to\-Cash, Credit Control or Accounts Receivable.
* Strong knowledge of collections, aged debt management, dispute resolution, legal recovery and insolvency processes.
* Working knowledge of cash allocation and customer and vendor master data controls.
* Hands\-on and adaptable approach, with the ability to move between leadership responsibilities and operational delivery.
* Strong people management, coaching, objective setting and performance management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to provide concise, meaningful commentary and meet reporting deadlines.
* Excellent planning, prioritisation, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* High level of accuracy, integrity and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience of ERP systems; SAP knowledge is preferred.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities and maintain service levels in a hybrid working environment.
* Service and Customer\-focused, results\-driven and committed to continuous improvement.

Education and Experience:


* Minimum three years of experience managing a team within Order\-to\-Cash, Credit Control, Accounts Receivable or a comparable transactional finance environment.
* Demonstrable experience of operational collections, complex debt recovery and stakeholder escalation.
* Experience of legal recovery, insolvency case management, cash allocation, master data or closely related OTC processes.
* Experience producing management information and performance reports with clear commentary to agreed deadlines.
* Experience in a high\-volume or Shared Services environment is desirable.
* CICM qualification or equivalent credit management accreditation is desirable.
* Experience of process automation, transformation or continuous improvement is desirable.

* Accountable and dependable, with a strong focus on accuracy, timeliness and follow\-through.

description:
### **Description**

  

MAPP is the UK’s leading specialist in commercial property and asset management, with over £30bn\+ of property under management for a wide range of UK and overseas fund managers, REITs and property owners.  

We believe property management can be a force for good. That’s why we focus on making buildings work — not just for profit, but for people and the planet too. Through our Property Management framework, we help clients and occupiers navigate a rapidly changing landscape, delivering a fully integrated and genuinely holistic approach.  

Most job descriptions read like a recipe without showing you what the finished dish should look like. We’d rather give you a clear picture of who we are, how we work, and the kind of person who thrives at MAPP.  

If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference here, we’d encourage you to apply — even if you don’t tick every box. We’re interested in people who want to do meaningful work, add real value, and be rewarded for their efforts in a genuinely great place to work.  

  

MAPP is an equal opportunities employer. All applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK by the start date of employment. MAPP does not provide immigration sponsorship.  

**Inclusion at MAPP**  

We want the real estate industry to be a career path where people feel both welcome and wanted. We’re proud of the progress we’ve made so far, but we’re always challenging ourselves to do better. We want the best people to see themselves thriving at MAPP. Creating an environment where everyone feels able to be themselves is essential to that – because diverse perspectives, lived experience and ways of thinking make us stronger.  

**Our values and how we work**  

Our MAPP values underpin everything we do. We were the first national real estate consultancy in the UK to become a B Corp, and that commitment to doing business responsibly shapes our decisions every day. We recently were reaccredited and improved our score significantly.  

We want you to learn, grow and challenge yourself. As a business, MAPP has grown consistently over the past five years, and we promote around 10% of our office\-based roles internally each year. We invest in development, create opportunities to broaden professional horizons, and make time to connect — through charity days, fundraising, learning initiatives and social events.  

**High expectations \& employee ownership**  

What makes MAPP distinctive is that we are owned by an Employee Ownership Trust. There are no external shareholders — our business is held on behalf of our people. This creates a more inclusive and transparent environment, where employees are informed, involved, and able to influence how we move forward. It also means that when the business succeeds, that success is shared — typically through a profit share that can be paid tax\-free to each individual.  

Being employee\-owned shapes the way we show up. It encourages us to think long term, take ownership of our decisions, and care about the impact of our work. We place a strong emphasis on trust, expecting people to use their judgement, take initiative, and support one another. Collaboration, curiosity, and accountability are key to maintaining both our performance and our culture.  

In return, we offer autonomy, support and the opportunity to grow in a business where your contribution genuinely matters.  

**Why join MAPP?**  

This role gives you the opportunity to be part of something a little bit special in property management. We’re always looking for great character — that’s what makes someone a MAPP person. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.  

**A few facts about MAPP you might like to know:**  

Our engagement scores are consistently high and in 2025, we had an engagement score of 83% and 92% of our people recommend MAPP as a great place to work.  

  

  

  

### **Title, Team and Role Summary**

  

**Title : Senior Client Accountant**  

  

**Team : Client Accounting**  

  

**Who Does This Role Report Into? Associate Director \- Client Accounting**  

  

**Role Summary / Purpose and Scope**  

This role is responsible for all aspects of client and property accounting overseeing a number of portfolios, working as part of a team to ensure the efficient and accurate accounting of client and tenant funds including the management of a number of teams### **Skills, Knowledge and Values**

 **Skills (People \& Technical)*** Billing of Service Charges, Rents, Voids, Recharges, Credits, Insurance Charges to Tenants / Occupiers or Clients
* Updating \& Maintaining property, lease \& occupier's data on Property Management Systems with appropriate regularity and consistency including site and contact information \& audit templates. Preparation of completion statements, rent review \& interest calculations
* Deal with the smooth onboarding and offboarding or handovers of any new or outgoing instructions to relevant external parties
* Support the preparation service charge budgets, including explanatory guides and analyse and monitor year end and monthly service charge expenditure, including monitoring outgoing costs and budgetary control in accordance with RICS guidance and investigate, report or address any outstanding positions and backlogs
* Produce, reconcile, analyse monthly client \& tenant deposit bank accounts, addressing any outstanding positions \& backlogs
* Preparation and submission of Financial reporting, Owner Statements, VAT Reports, Cashflows, Net Operating Income and other reports as required by the client
* Authorise and Review supplier payments including preparation and submission of funding requests to client
* Prepare, document and manage client payments and occupier / tenant refunds
* Provide Client Accounting leadership regarding all properties and portfolios under management including supporting asset management strategies, funding positions and client objectives in accordance with the PMA and other guidelines.
* To take responsibility for collating and presenting relevant data on a regular basis for review with team leaders at team meetings including assisting with Upward Reporting as well as meeting external reporting requirements for audits, client, statutory and national or global accreditation purposes
* Monitoring statutory and internal compliance, including meeting MAPP policies and procedures, RICS and ISO standards and any statutory timelines and escalation requirements

* Innovative Solutions and Problem Solving
* Developing Self and Others and willing to Learn
* Interpersonal and Relationship skills capable of communicating at various levels including meetings with occupiers, client, supplier and wider stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communications including report writing

Experience of working in a similar role

We are looking for a detailed, highly organised, and proactive Finance Specialist to join our team at Journey Further.


This role is ideal for an ambitious finance professional with 1 to 2 years of hands\-on experience who wants broad exposure across a fast paced marketing agency environment. Rather than being stuck in a single niche, you will manage core operational workflows. This means you will work across day to day credit control and complex ledger reconciliations to purchase orders and billing support.


You will work closely with our Revenue Operations (RevOps) team and Client Leads, ensuring our financial data is immaculate, our cash inflow is steady, and internal queries are resolved with speed and clarity.

**What you will do**

* Manage the day to day credit control cycle, contacting clients via phone and email to secure timely payments while maintaining great working relationships
* Act as the first point of contact for client billing queries, liaising with internal Client Leads to resolve scope, PO, or invoice disputes rapidly
* Perform credit checks for new clients, setup new accounts, and ensure billing details and payment terms are accurately captured in our system
* Monitor aged debtors daily, escalate persistent overdue accounts to the Finance Manager, and keep debtor notes up to date
* Perform daily bank reconciliations across multi currency accounts, ensuring all cash movements are matched accurately in our accounting software
* Prepare and maintain key monthly reconciliations, including bank, credit card, petty cash, and supplier statements
* Process incoming supplier invoices, verify purchase order (PO) approvals, schedule payment runs, and resolve supplier queries
* Assist the Finance Manager with basic month end preparation, including entering journals for accruals, prepayments, and deferred revenue
* Partner closely with RevOps to ensure client retainer models, media spend reconciliations, and project billing mirror active contracts
* Process staff expense submissions and monitor corporate credit card usage, ensuring compliance with company policy and correct VAT treatment
* Maintain clean, organised financial records and document workflows to ensure total audit readiness at all times
* Provide clear, prompt finance support to internal agency teams (Client Leads, Operations, People)

  

**Requirements**  

* 1–2 years of experience in a broad finance, accounting, or transactional role (agency, professional services, or fast\-growth business background is a plus)
* Direct experience handling credit control and ledger reconciliations (sets and recs)
* Proficiency with modern cloud accounting software (e.g., Xero) and confidence using spreadsheets (Google Sheets for data manipulation and lookups)
* Good foundational understanding of VAT rules and purchase order systems
* You aren't afraid to pick up the phone to chase an invoice or talk through a query with a client

**Corporate Tax Manager – Advisory**

**£60,000–£70,000**

**OTE £90,000 - £100,000**

**Fully Remote**

  


Our client is a high-growth tax and strategic advisory firm supporting entrepreneurs, privately owned businesses and ambitious companies across the UK and internationally.

  


The firm has grown significantly in recent years by combining high-level technical expertise with a modern, commercially focused approach to corporate tax advice.

  


As the business continues to scale, this is a key senior appointment for an experienced corporate tax professional who wants greater influence, genuine autonomy and the opportunity to help shape the future of an advisory-led tax function.

  


This is not a traditional, compliance-heavy accountancy practice. You will be joining an ambitious, founder-led advisory business with a high-calibre client base, a strong market profile and clear plans for continued growth.

  


**The Role**

  


You will work closely with the senior leadership team, taking responsibility for complex corporate tax advisory projects while helping to develop the firm’s wider corporate tax offering.

  


The client base includes founder-led businesses, owner-managed companies, scaling organisations and established privately owned groups. These are clients who require proactive, commercially intelligent advice rather than routine compliance support.

  


Many are growing rapidly, restructuring their operations, preparing for investment or sale, completing acquisitions, expanding internationally or dealing with increasingly complex corporate tax matters.

  


You will lead advisory projects, manage senior client relationships and provide clear, technically robust advice that considers both the immediate tax position and the client’s wider commercial objectives.

  


**Typical responsibilities will include:**

  


  * Leading complex corporate tax advisory engagements for owner-managed businesses, privately owned groups and entrepreneurial companies
  * Advising on corporate restructures, reorganisations, demergers and group simplification projects
  * Supporting clients through acquisitions, disposals, investments and other corporate transactions
  * Advising on tax-efficient growth strategies, succession planning and business exits
  * Providing advice on corporation tax matters, capital allowances, loss utilisation and group relief
  * Supporting businesses expanding or operating internationally
  * Identifying and advising on relevant tax reliefs and incentives
  * Acting as a trusted corporate tax adviser to business owners, directors and senior leadership teams
  * Reviewing technical work and helping to develop less experienced members of the tax team
  * Working with senior leadership to shape and grow the corporate tax advisory function
  * Identifying opportunities to improve technical standards, service delivery and client outcomes



  


**Why This Opportunity Stands Out**

  


This role offers access to the quality of work, client complexity and technical challenge often associated with larger firms, but within a more agile, entrepreneurial and genuinely influential environment.

  


You will not be one of many senior tax professionals within a large corporate structure. You will be a central figure in the firm’s next phase of growth, with visibility across the business and the opportunity to help build a corporate tax function of long-term value.

  


The firm has achieved significant year-on-year growth and continues to attract increasingly complex advisory projects. There is a clear strategy for the future, continued investment in technology and infrastructure, and a strong appetite to keep raising standards across the business.

  


For the right person, there is also the potential to benefit from extensive bonus incentives and longer-term equity participation.

  


**Your Profile**

  


This is a senior appointment, so it is essential that you already have a proven background in corporate tax advisory.

  


Ideally, you will have:

  


  * CTA, ACA, ACCA or CA qualification
  * Strong experience within corporate tax advisory
  * Experience advising owner-managed businesses, privately owned groups or entrepreneurial companies
  * The ability to lead complex advisory conversations and explain technical matters clearly
  * Experience advising on corporate restructures, transactions, reorganisations or business disposals
  * Strong technical knowledge and the ability to apply tax legislation within commercial scenarios
  * Experience reviewing complex corporate tax work
  * International tax exposure would be advantageous
  * The confidence to work closely with business owners, directors and senior stakeholders
  * An interest in helping to develop and grow a corporate tax advisory function



  


This role would suit an experienced Senior Corporate Tax Manager, Corporate Tax Manager or Senior Corporate Tax Advisor who wants to move into a more entrepreneurial, advisory-led environment offering genuine influence and long-term opportunity.

  


For further information or a confidential discussion, please get in touch.

## Full job description

**International Tax Manager**

**£60,000–£70,000 plus bonus**

**OTE £90,000 - £100,000**

**Fully Remote**

  


Our client is a fast-growing tax and strategic advisory firm supporting entrepreneurs, privately owned businesses and international groups across the UK and overseas.

  


The firm advises clients whose operations, investments and ownership structures increasingly span multiple jurisdictions. As the business continues to grow, it is looking to appoint an International Tax Manager who can lead complex cross-border advisory work and help shape the future development of its international tax offering.

  


This is a senior, client-facing role for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with a practical and commercial approach.

  


You will work directly with business owners, finance leaders and senior decision-makers, helping them understand the tax implications of operating, investing and expanding internationally.

  


**The Opportunity**

  


The role will involve advising UK businesses expanding overseas, international companies establishing a UK presence, privately owned groups with cross-border interests and entrepreneurs with increasingly complex international affairs.

  


Assignments may arise from international expansion, overseas investment, group restructuring, acquisitions, disposals, financing arrangements or changes to the way a business operates across different countries.

  


You will lead projects from initial scoping through to delivery, coordinating with overseas advisers where required and ensuring clients receive clear, joined-up advice.

  


Rather than operating within a narrowly defined international tax team, you will have broad exposure across corporate, transaction and owner-managed business matters.

  


**What You’ll Be Advising On**

  


Your responsibilities will include:

  


  * Advising UK businesses expanding into overseas markets
  * Supporting international groups establishing or growing their operations in the UK
  * Advising on cross-border corporate structures and international reorganisations
  * Reviewing the tax implications of overseas subsidiaries, branches and permanent establishments
  * Advising on double tax treaties and the availability of treaty relief
  * Supporting clients with withholding tax considerations
  * Advising on the UK tax treatment of cross-border payments, financing and investment
  * Providing guidance on controlled foreign company rules and other anti-avoidance provisions
  * Advising on corporate residence and permanent establishment risk
  * Supporting international acquisitions, disposals and wider transactions
  * Working with overseas tax advisers to coordinate advice across multiple jurisdictions
  * Identifying tax risks and planning opportunities within international business structures
  * Explaining complex international tax matters clearly to business owners and senior stakeholders
  * Reviewing technical work and maintaining consistently high standards
  * Supporting the development of junior colleagues
  * Helping senior leadership develop and grow the firm’s international tax proposition



  


**A Commercial Approach to International Tax**

  


The clients are not looking for theoretical advice delivered in isolation.

  


They need someone who can understand their commercial objectives, identify the issues that genuinely matter and provide practical recommendations that can be implemented.

  


You may be advising a founder-led company preparing to enter a new territory, an overseas business establishing a UK operation or an established group reviewing whether its current structure remains appropriate.

  


The work will regularly overlap with corporate tax, M&A, restructuring and private client matters, providing exposure to a broad range of complex advisory projects.

  


**Why This Role Stands Out**

  


This is an opportunity to undertake high-quality international tax work without becoming restricted to one narrow technical area.

  


You will have genuine ownership of assignments, direct access to senior decision-makers and the ability to influence how the international tax function develops as the firm continues to scale.

  


The business has achieved significant year-on-year growth and continues to invest in its people, technology and infrastructure.

  


It offers the technical challenge and client complexity commonly associated with larger firms, combined with the autonomy, pace and visibility of a founder-led advisory business.

For the right person, the package may also include substantial performance-related bonus incentives and the potential for longer-term equity participation.

  


**Your Background**

  


You will already have a strong grounding in international corporate tax and experience advising businesses on cross-border matters.

  


Ideally, you will have:

  


  * CTA, ACA, ACCA, CA or an equivalent professional qualification
  * Strong experience within international or corporate tax advisory
  * Experience advising UK businesses with overseas operations or international groups operating in the UK
  * Knowledge of double tax treaties, withholding taxes and permanent establishment matters
  * Experience advising on cross-border structures, reorganisations or transactions
  * An understanding of corporate residence, controlled foreign companies and international anti-avoidance rules
  * The ability to identify both technical risk and commercial opportunity
  * Confidence managing complex advisory projects and senior client relationships
  * The ability to explain technical matters clearly to non-tax specialists
  * Strong project-management and stakeholder-management skills
  * Experience reviewing work and supporting the development of junior colleagues
  * Broader exposure to transaction tax, transfer pricing or owner-managed businesses would be advantageous



  


Applications are welcomed from established International Tax Managers, as well as ambitious Assistant Managers or experienced Corporate Tax Advisors with strong international exposure who are ready to take the next step.

  


For further information or a confidential discussion, please get in touch.

## Full job description

**Your new company**

A leading global professional services firm is seeking an ambitious Corporate Tax Senior Manager to join its growing tax practice in Leeds. With a reputation for delivering market-leading tax, audit and advisory services, the firm works with a diverse portfolio of large corporates, international groups, privately owned businesses and private equity-backed organisations.

The Corporate Tax team is experiencing significant growth, creating an excellent opportunity for an experienced tax professional to take on a highly visible leadership role. You'll join a collaborative and high-performing team where technical excellence, innovation and career development are genuinely valued. Supported by an experienced leadership team, you'll have the opportunity to influence strategy, develop future talent and play a key role in the continued expansion of the practice.

This role offers a clear pathway towards Director level and would suit either an established Senior Manager seeking greater leadership responsibility or an ambitious Manager ready for the next step in their career.  
  
**Your new role**

As a Corporate Tax Senior Manager, you will lead the delivery of complex compliance and advisory projects while developing trusted relationships with a broad range of clients. You will work closely with Directors and Partners to support the growth of the practice and help clients navigate an increasingly complex tax landscape.Key responsibilities will include:  
* Building and maintaining strong client relationships, becoming a trusted adviser on a wide range of corporate tax matters.  
* Leading the delivery of corporate tax compliance and advisory services to a varied client portfolio.  
* Managing technically complex projects, including group restructurings, refinancing transactions, legal entity simplification, pre and post-deal reorganisations, tax authority enquiries and BEPS Pillar Two implementation.  
* Providing specialist technical support across the wider tax team on complex corporate tax matters.  
* Taking a leadership role in business development activities, identifying opportunities and supporting growth initiatives.  
* Managing proposals, tenders and client pitches, helping to secure new business opportunities.  
* Working collaboratively with specialists across the UK and international network on multinational assignments.  
* Supporting the strategic development of the tax team, including resource planning and operational improvements.  
* Coaching, mentoring and developing junior team members, helping to build the next generation of tax professionals.  
* Acting as a role model by fostering a positive, inclusive and high-performance culture.  
  
**What you'll need to succeed**

To be successful in this role, you will be a qualified tax professional with strong corporate tax technical expertise and proven experience of managing complex client relationships.You will ideally have:  
* ACA, ACCA, CTA, CA or equivalent professional qualification.  
* Extensive corporate tax experience gained within a professional services environment.  
* Experience of advising on complex tax matters, including international tax issues and large corporate projects.  
* Knowledge of key tax developments such as BEPS Pillar Two, hybrid mismatch rules, restructurings and transaction-related tax advice.  
* A proven track record of leading projects and delivering high-quality client service.  
* Experience managing, mentoring and developing teams.  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  
* Strong commercial awareness with the ability to provide pragmatic, business-focused advice.  
* The drive, ambition and leadership qualities required to progress towards Director level.  
  
**What you'll get in return**

In return, you'll join a firm that is heavily invested in the development and success of its people, offering excellent opportunities for progression and a highly competitive rewards package.  
* Competitive salary and performance-related bonus.  
* Clear progression pathway to Director.  
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.  
* Advanced technical training and leadership development programmes.  
* Comprehensive pension scheme.  
* Private medical insurance.  
* Life assurance.  
* Group income protection and personal accident cover.  
* Enhanced family leave policies.  
* 25 days annual leave, with the option to purchase additional holiday.  
* Additional birthday leave.  
* Flexible benefits scheme, including gym memberships, travel insurance, dental cover and wellbeing benefits.  
* Employee discounts and financial wellbeing support.  
* Paid volunteering days to support charitable causes.  
* 24/7 GP access and employee assistance programme.  
* Exposure to high-profile clients, complex international projects and a market-leading tax team.  
This is an outstanding opportunity for a corporate tax professional looking to take the next step in their career within a firm that combines technical excellence, ambitious growth plans and a genuinely supportive culture.

**Mergers & Acquisitions Tax Manager**

**£60,000–£70,000 plus bonus**

**OTE £90,000 - £100,000**

**Fully Remote**

  


Our client is a high-growth tax and strategic advisory firm working with entrepreneurs, investors, privately owned businesses and ambitious companies across the UK and internationally.

  


The firm supports clients through some of the most important stages in their business journey, including acquisitions, disposals, investment, restructuring and preparation for exit.

  


Following continued growth, the business is looking to appoint a Mergers & Acquisitions Tax Manager who can lead complex transaction-related tax projects and provide clear, commercially focused advice to business owners and senior leadership teams.

  


This is an opportunity to undertake high-quality, technically challenging work within an entrepreneurial advisory firm where you will have genuine autonomy, direct access to decision-makers and the chance to help shape a growing M&A tax offering.

  


**The Role**

  


You will work closely with the firm’s senior leadership team, advising clients throughout the transaction lifecycle.

  


Your clients will include founder-led businesses, privately owned groups, entrepreneurs, investors and management teams considering a sale, acquisition, investment or wider corporate transaction.

  


You may become involved at the earliest planning stages, helping business owners understand the tax implications of a proposed transaction and identify the most appropriate structure.

  


You will then remain closely involved as the deal progresses, working alongside lawyers, corporate finance advisers, accountants and other specialists to manage risk, resolve technical issues and help achieve the best possible outcome for the client.

  


The role will involve a combination of technical tax advisory work, project leadership and senior client management. You will be expected to look beyond the legislation and understand the commercial purpose of each transaction.

  


**Key Responsibilities**

  


  * Leading tax advisory projects connected to business acquisitions, disposals and investments
  * Advising shareholders, entrepreneurs and management teams before a business sale or exit
  * Supporting clients with the tax structuring of proposed transactions
  * Undertaking tax due diligence and identifying potential risks, exposures and planning opportunities
  * Advising on share sales, asset sales, management buyouts and management buy-ins
  * Supporting corporate reorganisations, demergers and pre-transaction restructuring
  * Advising on capital gains tax, corporation tax and shareholder tax considerations
  * Reviewing transaction documentation from a tax perspective
  * Advising on warranties, indemnities and tax-related provisions within sale and purchase agreements
  * Working alongside legal, corporate finance and other professional advisers throughout the deal process
  * Presenting technical findings and recommendations clearly to business owners and senior stakeholders
  * Reviewing technical work and supporting the development of less experienced team members
  * Helping to develop the firm’s M&A and transaction tax proposition
  * Identifying opportunities to support clients beyond the immediate transaction



  


**The Clients and the Work**

  


The firm’s client base includes entrepreneurs, privately owned companies and established business groups operating across a variety of sectors.

  


Some clients will be preparing for their first acquisition. Others may be considering the sale of a business they have built over many years, taking external investment or implementing a wider succession strategy.

  


The work is varied, commercially significant and often time-sensitive. Clients need an adviser who can explain complex tax matters clearly, understand the wider deal dynamics and remain calm when issues arise.

  


You will have the opportunity to become closely involved in transactions rather than completing one isolated element of the process.

  


**Why Join?**

  


  * This is not a large, heavily structured deals team where responsibilities are narrowly divided between different departments.
  * You will have broad exposure across the transaction lifecycle and the freedom to take genuine ownership of your work.
  * The firm combines the calibre and complexity of assignments often associated with larger professional services businesses with the pace, flexibility and influence of a founder-led advisory firm.
  * You will work directly with senior decision-makers, develop close relationships with clients and contribute to the continued growth of the M&A tax function.
  * The business has achieved significant year-on-year growth and continues to invest in its people, technology and infrastructure.
  * For the right person, the package may also include substantial performance-related bonus incentives and the potential for longer-term equity participation.



  


**Your Background**

  


You will already have strong experience within corporate tax, transaction tax, deals tax or M&A advisory.

  


  * CTA, ACA, ACCA, CA or an equivalent professional qualification
  * Experience advising on mergers, acquisitions, disposals or business investments
  * A strong technical background in corporate tax or transaction tax
  * Experience undertaking or reviewing tax due diligence
  * Knowledge of transaction structuring and pre-sale reorganisations
  * An understanding of the tax considerations arising from share and asset sales
  * The ability to interpret complex information and identify commercially significant issues
  * Confidence advising entrepreneurs, shareholders, investors and senior management teams
  * Strong project-management skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines
  * The ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-tax specialists
  * Experience reviewing work or supporting the development of junior colleagues
  * International transaction tax exposure would be advantageous



  


The firm will consider an established M&A Tax Manager or Transaction Tax Manager, as well as an ambitious Assistant Manager or experienced Corporate Tax Advisor with strong transaction exposure who is ready to progress.

**Private Client Tax Manager**

**£60,000–£70,000 plus bonus**

**OTE £90,000 - £100,000**

  


**Fully Remote**

  


Are you an experienced private client tax professional looking for greater autonomy, more complex advisory work and the opportunity to help shape a growing tax function?

  


Our client is a high-growth tax and strategic advisory firm working with entrepreneurs, business owners, high-net-worth individuals and families across the UK and internationally.

  


Following significant year-on-year growth, the firm is looking to appoint a Private Client Tax Manager who can take ownership of senior client relationships and deliver commercially focused advice across a broad range of complex personal tax matters.

  


This is an opportunity to work with the calibre of clients and technical assignments often associated with a larger firm, but within a modern, entrepreneurial environment where you will have genuine visibility and influence.

  


**The Opportunity**

  


You will manage a portfolio of high-value private clients, including entrepreneurs, company directors, business owners and families with significant personal and generational wealth.

  


The work will be predominantly advisory-led. Clients may be preparing to sell a business, restructuring their personal affairs, planning for succession, relocating internationally or considering how best to protect and transfer wealth to future generations.

  


You will work closely with the firm’s senior leadership team, leading complex assignments and becoming a trusted adviser to clients whose personal, family and business interests are often closely connected.

  


Rather than simply responding to tax matters as they arise, you will take a proactive approach, identifying planning opportunities and helping clients make informed long-term decisions.

  


**What You’ll Be Doing**

  


Your responsibilities will include:

  


  * Managing and developing relationships with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals
  * Advising entrepreneurs, shareholders, company directors and privately wealthy families
  * Delivering advice on income tax, capital gains tax and inheritance tax
  * Supporting clients with succession, estate and intergenerational wealth planning
  * Advising shareholders before and after business sales, investments and other transactions
  * Providing guidance on trusts, family investment companies and other wealth-holding structures
  * Supporting clients with residence, domicile and international personal tax matters
  * Working alongside corporate tax and transaction specialists where clients have connected business interests
  * Reviewing complex technical work and ensuring consistently high standards
  * Helping to coach and develop less experienced members of the tax team
  * Identifying opportunities to broaden client relationships and improve service delivery
  * Contributing to the continued development of the firm’s private client tax offering



  


**A Different Kind of Tax Firm**

  


This is not a traditional, compliance-heavy accountancy practice.

  


The business has been built around providing technically strong, commercially relevant advice to ambitious clients with increasingly complex requirements.

  


You will be trusted to manage your own relationships, lead advisory conversations and use your judgement rather than working within a rigid corporate structure.

  


The firm continues to invest in its people, technology and infrastructure, with a clear strategy for further growth. You will join at a point where you can make a visible contribution to how the private client function develops.

  


For the right person, the package may also include significant performance-related bonus incentives and the potential for longer-term equity participation.

  


**What We’re Looking For**

  


You will already have a strong background in private client tax and be comfortable advising clients on complex and sensitive financial matters.

  


Ideally, you will have:

  


  * CTA, ACA, ACCA, CA or an equivalent professional qualification
  * Strong private client or personal tax advisory experience
  * Experience working with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs or business-owning families
  * Knowledge of income tax, capital gains tax and inheritance tax
  * Exposure to trusts, succession planning or wealth structuring
  * The ability to interpret legislation and apply it to complex real-life situations
  * Excellent communication skills and the confidence to lead senior client conversations
  * Experience reviewing work and supporting the development of junior colleagues
  * International private client tax experience would be advantageous
  * A proactive, commercial and relationship-led approach



  


Applications are welcomed from established Private Client Tax Managers, as well as ambitious Assistant Managers or Senior Private Client Tax Advisors who are ready to step into a broader role.

  


For further information or a confidential discussion, please get in touch.

Our expertise in community wealth building has gained international recognition, and we embody our progressive ethos by offering a four-day full-pay working week. At CLES, we foster a deeply collaborative and flexible environment where strong relationships are valued, reflected in our regular social activities and annual residential gatherings.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Head of Finance and Operations who will play a crucial role in steering our financial and operational functions. Working closely with our senior management team, you will combine strategic insights with hands-on delivery, ensuring the efficient management of our financial systems, governance, and HR processes. You will be supported by a dedicated Finance and Office Administrator, allowing you to focus on higher-level financial oversight and operational excellence.

  * Excellent organisational skills and a proactive, solutions-focused approach to work.
  * Proven ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, building trust and collaboration.

**Job Title**

Senior Client Manager

Bolton

An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced **Senior Client Manager** to join a well-established and growing Top 20 accountancy practice. This is a key leadership role, offering the chance to manage an established client portfolio, lead a high-performing accounts team, and play an integral part in the continued growth and development of the business.

  


This position is ideal for an ambitious practice professional looking to step into a strategic role with genuine long-term career progression.

  


In this role, you'll be responsible for managing a portfolio of established SME clients while leading, mentoring and developing the accounts team. You'll provide trusted business advice, oversee compliance work, identify advisory opportunities and support the ongoing modernisation of the practice.

  


**What you will be doing as a Senior Client Manager**

  


  * Managing a portfolio of limited company clients, delivering proactive business advice and exceptional client service.
  * Building strong, long-term client relationships and identifying opportunities to provide additional advisory services.
  * Leading client assignments from planning through to completion, including statutory accounts, management accounts, corporation tax, personal tax and VAT returns.
  * Providing tailored financial and commercial advice to support clients' business growth.
  * Overseeing compliance deadlines across accounts, VAT, corporation tax, self-assessment and Companies House filings.
  * Supporting Portfolio Managers with complex accounting and technical matters.
  * Managing, mentoring and developing senior and junior team members through coaching, performance management and training.
  * Advising clients on tax planning matters, including remuneration strategies, pensions and capital assets.
  * Working closely with specialist tax teams and credit control to ensure a seamless client experience.
  * Supporting the implementation of new technology, cloud accounting solutions and improved working practices.
  * Leading process improvement and standardisation projects across the practice.
  * Supporting business development activities, client onboarding and identifying opportunities for growth.



  


**What you will need to succeed as a Senior Client Manager**

  


  * ACA or ACCA qualification.
  * Significant experience within an accountancy practice managing your own client portfolio.
  * Strong technical knowledge across accounts preparation, corporation tax and VAT.
  * Good understanding of personal tax.
  * Excellent knowledge of FRS 102 reporting standards.
  * Proven leadership experience, including managing, reviewing and developing team members.
  * Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  * A commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities to add value for clients.
  * Experience using cloud accounting software, particularly Xero.
  * Familiarity with accounting software such as Dext, CCH or similar would be advantageous.
  * A proactive, organised and client-focused approach.
  * A genuine passion for mentoring and developing others.



  


**Why join this firm?**

  


  * Competitive salary.

  * 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.

  * Christmas office closure (subject to business requirements).
  * Life assurance (4x salary).
  * Enhanced family leave policies.
  * Enhanced company sick pay.
  * Employee Assistance Programme providing 24/7 confidential support.
  * Employee discounts platform.
  * Flexible benefits, including options for critical illness cover, health cash plan, cycle to work scheme, eye care and dental cover.

## Full job description

An award winning, established and highly regarded independent accountancy practice with over 100 years of history, this firm has built a strong reputation for providing friendly, commercially focused advice to a diverse portfolio of SMEs, owner-managed businesses and growing companies. The firm works across a broad range of sectors and provides accounts, tax, audit and wider business advisory services.

  


With a strong emphasis on long-term client relationships, approachable service and staff development, this is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Accountant to join a supportive team where they will gain genuine exposure to clients and develop their technical and advisory skills.  


**Senior Accountant - Overview**

  


  * Manage a portfolio of SME clients, acting as their main point of contact.
  * Prepare year-end statutory accounts and corporation tax computations.
  * Prepare and review monthly and quarterly management accounts.
  * Attend regular client meetings, providing commercial advice and identifying potential tax-saving opportunities.
  * Review VAT returns for a varied client base.
  * Complete up to 10 audits per year from planning through to completion (audit experience beneficial but not essential).
  * Assist with the preparation of charity accounts where required, with training available.
  * Work closely with a collaborative team while building long-term client relationships.



  


**Senior Accountant - Requirements**

  


  * ACA or ACCA qualified, part-qualified or qualified by experience.
  * Previous experience within an accountancy practice.
  * Strong experience preparing statutory accounts and corporation tax returns.
  * Experience producing and reviewing management accounts.
  * Confident managing a client portfolio and attending client meetings.
  * Knowledge of VAT returns.
  * Audit experience or an interest in maintaining audit exposure would be highly advantageous.
  * Charity accounts experience would be beneficial but is not essential.
  * Excellent communication and organisational skills.



  


**Senior Accountant - Salary & Benefits**

  


  * £35,000 - £45,000 depending on experience.
  * Hybrid working (1 day from home following successful completion of probation).
  * Flexible working hours:
  * Monday - Thursday: 9:00am - 5:15pm
  * Friday: 9:00am - 1:00pm
  * 20 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with additional flexibility for more experienced candidates.
  * Company pension.
  * On-site parking.
  * Supportive, friendly working environment with long-term career progression.

# Senior Logistics Manager

19 August by Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited

  * £60,000 - £85,000 per annum
  * Warrington, Cheshire
  * Temporary, full-time
  * Skills: Logistics, International Trade \+ 2 more




Apply nowSave

## Full job description

Your new company   
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Logistics Manager to lead our UK logistics operation on a fixed-term basis until March 2027. This is a high-profile leadership role responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant and cost-effective movement of inbound and outbound materials across domestic and international supply chains.  
As a key member of the Leadership Team, you will play a vital role in driving operational excellence, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction and sustainable business growth within a fast-paced and innovative manufacturing environment.  
This is an excellent opportunity for a proven logistics leader with significant expertise in transport, customs, international trade compliance and continuous improvement.  
Your new role   
Reporting into senior leadership, you will be accountable for the overall performance of the UK logistics function, ensuring the effective management of transport operations, customs compliance, import and export activities, logistics providers and strategic improvement initiatives.You will provide leadership to the logistics team while driving transformation projects, enhancing operational efficiency and ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements.  
Key Responsibilities  
Leadership & Team Development

  * Develop and deliver the logistics strategy aligned to wider business objectives.
  * Lead, coach and develop the Logistics team, driving engagement and performance.
  * Manage performance, absence management and employee development plans.
  * Build capability through succession planning, skills development and talent management.
  * Contribute as a key member of the Leadership Team.



Transport & Logistics Management

  * Lead inbound and outbound logistics operations across road, air and sea freight.
  * Manage relationships with transport providers, freight forwarders and courier partners.
  * Optimise transportation costs, service levels and operational capacity.
  * Ensure efficient and reliable supply chain performance across domestic and international markets.



Customs & Trade Compliance

  * Own UK customs compliance and import/export operations.
  * Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations, customs legislation, VAT requirements and Incoterms.
  * Manage customs brokers and oversee tariff classifications, customs valuations and country of origin processes.
  * Lead all aspects of Inward Processing Relief (IPR), Bills of Discharge and customs audits.
  * Ensure robust governance and compliance regarding customs duties and VAT obligations.



Dangerous Goods Management

  * Ensure compliance with ADR, IATA and IMDG regulations.
  * Oversee dangerous goods packaging, labelling, documentation and training requirements.
  * Maintain the highest standards of safety and regulatory compliance across logistics operations.



Continuous Improvement & Transformation

  * Lead logistics transformation, automation and systems projects, including SAP and related logistics platforms.
  * Drive Lean, Kaizen, A3PS and continuous improvement initiatives.
  * Develop and monitor KPIs to improve service, efficiency and cost performance.
  * Manage budgets, supplier performance and contractual agreements.
  * Lead logistics risk management, audit actions and business continuity planning.



  
What you'll need to succeed   
To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate:

  * Extensive senior logistics leadership experience within manufacturing, engineering or another highly regulated environment.
  * Strong expertise in transport management, freight operations and international logistics.
  * In-depth knowledge of customs legislation, HMRC compliance, VAT, IPR and Bills of Discharge.
  * Experience managing Dangerous Goods operations, with DGSA qualification advantageous.
  * Strong SAP or equivalent ERP systems experience.
  * Proven ability to lead complex projects, business transformation and change initiatives.
  * Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma or continuous improvement methodologies.
  * Excellent commercial awareness, analytical skills and stakeholder management capability.
  * Outstanding leadership, coaching and communication skills.
  * A collaborative and proactive approach with a passion for driving performance and continuous improvement.



What you'll get in return   
You will get the opportunity to work for a market-leading organisation that provides a first-class working environment for their employees. The role is on an FTC basis until the end of March 2027, and you will be paid between 60k-85k FTE depending on experience.   
  
You'll have the autonomy to shape logistics strategy, lead meaningful transformation programmes and work closely with senior stakeholders to deliver tangible business improvements.  
If you are a highly motivated logistics professional looking for your next leadership challenge, we'd love to hear from you.You will work on site in Warrington full time Monday-Friday (8:30-16:15) and there is free parking on site. The company also offers a first class subsidised canteen.   
  
What you need to do now   
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.  
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

**Finance Manager | Rochdale (4 days in office) | £65,000 - £75,000 | Manufacturing**

  * Lead and develop a finance team of 6 direct reports

  * Strong management accounting and financial reporting experience
  * Experience with Microsoft Dynamics Navision would be advantageous

  * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  * A proactive approach with strong attention to detail and the ability to meet tight reporting deadlines

  * Opportunity to lead a broad finance function within a successful international manufacturing business
  * High level of exposure to senior leadership and Group Finance
  * A varied role combining financial control, reporting and commercial business partnering

**Your new company**  
Your new organisation is a respected not-for-profit Trust with a long-standing presence within the local area, dedicated to enhancing the lives of residents through a diverse portfolio of community-focused services. Supporting health, wellbeing, cultural engagement and social inclusion, the Trust operates across a number of locations and positively impacts thousands of people each year. **Your new role**  
As Finance Manager, you will take ownership of the organisation's financial operations, ensuring effective financial management, governance and compliance across the Trust. You will lead on financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting activities, while maintaining strong financial controls and driving continuous improvements to systems and processes. The role will include overseeing the preparation of accounts in accordance with SORP and FRS standards, managing VAT requirements including partial exemption, and providing insightful financial analysis to support strategic decision-making. You will also play a key role in business planning, financial strategy, performance monitoring and identifying opportunities to maximise funding and income streams. In addition, you will lead and develop the finance team, fostering a high-performing and customer-focused finance function.  
  
**What you'll need to succeed**  
To be successful in this role, you will be a qualified ACA, ACCA or CIMA accountant with significant post-qualification experience in a finance leadership position. You will possess strong expertise in financial management, budgeting, forecasting and business planning, alongside experience of implementing and improving financial systems and controls. A sound understanding of VAT accounting, including partial exemption, and experience preparing accounts under SORP and FRS frameworks will be essential. Previous experience within the charity or not-for-profit sector would be beneficial. You will also be an effective people manager, capable of leading, developing and motivating teams, with excellent communication, organisational and stakeholder management skills.  
  
**What you'll get in return**  
In return, you will join a values-led organisation where you can make a meaningful contribution to the local community. This is an opportunity to lead a broad and varied finance function, partner with senior leaders and influence key strategic decisions. You'll benefit from a supportive and collaborative working environment that encourages innovation, continuous improvement and professional growth, together with a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

## Full job description

I’m working with a well-established independent accountancy practice in **Altrincham** that is looking to recruit a **qualified accountant** to join its friendly and experienced team.

This is a broad, hands-on role where you will take responsibility for your own portfolio of clients and manage their accounts work from start to finish.

The position would suit someone who enjoys working in a smaller practice environment, building strong relationships with clients and getting involved in a varied range of work rather than being restricted to one particular area.

They are looking to offer a salary in the region of **£40,000 - £50,000** , depending on experience, alongside a pleasant working environment and a good degree of flexibility.

**Duties and responsibilities**  


The role will involve managing a varied portfolio of owner-managed businesses and providing a broad range of accountancy services.

Typical responsibilities will include:

  * Managing your own portfolio of clients
  * Preparing year-end accounts for limited companies, sole traders and partnerships
  * Managing accounts assignments from initial bookkeeping records through to completion
  * Preparing corporation tax computations and returns
  * Preparing personal tax returns where required
  * Reviewing bookkeeping and accounting records
  * Preparing and submitting VAT returns
  * Assisting clients with bookkeeping queries and general accounting matters
  * Getting involved with payroll work where required
  * Liaising directly with clients and becoming a trusted point of contact
  * Managing deadlines and ensuring work is completed accurately and efficiently
  * Supporting junior members of staff where appropriate
  * Working closely with the Partners on more complex client matters and ad hoc projects



This is very much a **general practice role** , so there is plenty of variety and the opportunity to get involved across accounts, tax, bookkeeping, payroll and wider client advisory work.

**Experience and qualifications**  


The successful individual will ideally be:

  * ACA or ACCA qualified
  * Experienced within an accountancy practice environment
  * Comfortable preparing accounts from start to finish
  * Experienced managing or taking responsibility for a portfolio of clients
  * Confident dealing directly with owner-managed businesses
  * Familiar with corporation tax, VAT and general practice work
  * Organised and able to manage a number of different client deadlines
  * Comfortable working independently while also contributing as part of a small team



Experience across bookkeeping, payroll and personal tax would be useful, although they do not expect someone to be a specialist in every area.

The role could suit someone currently working as an **Accounts Senior, Client Manager, Accounts Manager or qualified general practice accountant** who would like more autonomy and client responsibility.

**Benefits**  


The package will depend on experience but is expected to include:

  * Salary of approximately **£40,000 - £50,000**
  * Flexible working arrangements
  * A friendly and relaxed independent practice environment
  * Broad exposure to a varied portfolio of clients
  * Opportunity to manage your own client relationships
  * Variety across accounts, tax, bookkeeping and payroll
  * Good level of autonomy in managing your workload
  * Opportunity to work closely with the Partners and senior members of the business
  * Genuine scope to develop your responsibilities over time.

**Company culture**  


This is a **small independent accountancy practice** with a friendly, professional and down-to-earth working environment.

They have built long-standing relationships with many of their clients and place a strong emphasis on providing a personal service rather than operating in a highly corporate or target-driven environment.

Because of the size of the practice, employees are given a good level of responsibility and exposure to clients, while also having the support of experienced colleagues around them.

It should particularly appeal to someone who enjoys the variety and autonomy of working within an independent firm and wants a role where they can manage clients properly, get involved across different areas of practice and become an important part of the team.

We’re recruiting for a profitable, growing multi-million-pound business based in the South Manchester area that is looking to appoint an experienced Interim Finance Manager.  
  
Initially offered on a 6–12 month basis, this is an immediate requirement and there is the potential for the role to become permanent longer term.  
  
The business has grown significantly over recent years and is entering another important period in its development. They need someone who can come in quickly, take ownership of the day-to-day finance function and provide stability, structure and strong financial reporting.  
  
This is a broad, hands-on role sitting within the Senior Management Team and working closely with the CFO and wider leadership team.  
  
**The role**  
  
You’ll be responsible for:  


  * Producing monthly management accounts from start to finish
  * P&L reporting, variance analysis and commentary
  * Consolidating financial results across multiple entities
  * Preparing monthly accounts for an overseas entity
  * Completing balance sheet reconciliations
  * Managing the nominal, sales and purchase ledgers
  * Managing and supporting an Accounts Assistant
  * Preparing and reviewing VAT returns
  * Managing foreign currency transactions
  * Supporting budgeting and forecasting alongside the CFO
  * Preparing payroll information for an external payroll provider
  * Developing and strengthening finance policies, processes and controls
  * Working with analysts to improve management information and reporting
  * Supporting external audit and liaising with auditors
  * Producing financial information relating to a separate trust structure
  * Presenting monthly financial results to senior stakeholders and the Board
  * Working closely with managers across the business to improve financial understanding and decision-making

The business operates Sage alongside a specialist industry system, so previous Sage experience would be useful but isn’t essential.

  * Good technical accounting knowledge
  * Strong Excel skills
  * Confidence working with senior stakeholders
  * A proactive, commercially minded approach
