  * Strong communication and relationship-building skills

This role will suit someone confident and resilient who enjoys taking ownership and is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with strong personalities and high expectations.  
  
**Why consider it?**  
  
This is an opportunity to join a profitable, well-established business that has grown strongly and is entering an interesting period of change and development.  
  
The initial 6–12 month interim assignment offers the chance to make an immediate impact, with the possibility of a permanent role for the right person if both sides want to continue the relationship.  
  
The company also offers:  


  * Hybrid working
  * 26 days’ holiday + bank holidays, plus your birthday off
  * Healthcare and wellbeing package, including remote GP and mental health support
  * Death in Service and company sick pay
  * Enhanced family-friendly policies

The requirement is immediate, so candidates who are available now or at short notice are particularly encouraged to apply.

They are looking to offer a salary in the region of **£40,000 - £50,000** , depending on experience, alongside a pleasant working environment and a good degree of flexibility.

  * Managing accounts assignments from initial bookkeeping records through to completion
  * Preparing corporation tax computations and returns
  * Preparing personal tax returns where required

  * Preparing and submitting VAT returns
  * Assisting clients with bookkeeping queries and general accounting matters
  * Getting involved with payroll work where required
  * Liaising directly with clients and becoming a trusted point of contact
  * Managing deadlines and ensuring work is completed accurately and efficiently
  * Supporting junior members of staff where appropriate
  * Working closely with the Partners on more complex client matters and ad hoc projects

**Experience and qualifications**  


The successful individual will ideally be:

  * ACA or ACCA qualified
  * Experienced within an accountancy practice environment
  * Comfortable preparing accounts from start to finish
  * Experienced managing or taking responsibility for a portfolio of clients
  * Confident dealing directly with owner-managed businesses
  * Familiar with corporation tax, VAT and general practice work
  * Organised and able to manage a number of different client deadlines
  * Comfortable working independently while also contributing as part of a small team

  * A friendly and relaxed independent practice environment
  * Broad exposure to a varied portfolio of clients
  * Opportunity to manage your own client relationships
  * Variety across accounts, tax, bookkeeping and payroll
  * Good level of autonomy in managing your workload
  * Opportunity to work closely with the Partners and senior members of the business
  * Genuine scope to develop your responsibilities over time.

**Company culture**  


This is a **small independent accountancy practice** with a friendly, professional and down-to-earth working environment.

They have built long-standing relationships with many of their clients and place a strong emphasis on providing a personal service rather than operating in a highly corporate or target-driven environment.

Because of the size of the practice, employees are given a good level of responsibility and exposure to clients, while also having the support of experienced colleagues around them.

It should particularly appeal to someone who enjoys the variety and autonomy of working within an independent firm and wants a role where they can manage clients properly, get involved across different areas of practice and become an important part of the team.

**  
We’re recruiting for a profitable, growing multi-million-pound business based in the South Manchester area that is looking to appoint an experienced Interim Finance Manager.  
  
Initially offered on a 6–12 month basis, this is an immediate requirement and there is the potential for the role to become permanent longer term.  
  
The business has grown significantly over recent years and is entering another important period in its development. They need someone who can come in quickly, take ownership of the day-to-day finance function and provide stability, structure and strong financial reporting.  
  
This is a broad, hands-on role sitting within the Senior Management Team and working closely with the CFO and wider leadership team.  
  
**The role**  
  
You’ll be responsible for:  


  * Producing monthly management accounts from start to finish
  * P&L reporting, variance analysis and commentary
  * Consolidating financial results across multiple entities
  * Preparing monthly accounts for an overseas entity
  * Completing balance sheet reconciliations
  * Managing the nominal, sales and purchase ledgers
  * Managing and supporting an Accounts Assistant
  * Preparing and reviewing VAT returns
  * Managing foreign currency transactions
  * Supporting budgeting and forecasting alongside the CFO
  * Preparing payroll information for an external payroll provider
  * Developing and strengthening finance policies, processes and controls
  * Working with analysts to improve management information and reporting
  * Supporting external audit and liaising with auditors
  * Producing financial information relating to a separate trust structure
  * Presenting monthly financial results to senior stakeholders and the Board
  * Working closely with managers across the business to improve financial understanding and decision-making

The business operates Sage alongside a specialist industry system, so previous Sage experience would be useful but isn’t essential.  
  
**About you**  
  
We’re ideally looking for an ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified Finance Manager with strong hands-on management accounting experience.You’ll need to be comfortable stepping into a business quickly, getting to grips with the numbers and building credibility with senior stakeholders from the outset.You’ll ideally bring:  


  * ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualification
  * Strong management accounts experience
  * Experience managing or supervising others
  * Good technical accounting knowledge
  * Strong Excel skills
  * Confidence working with senior stakeholders
  * A proactive, commercially minded approach
  * The ability to challenge constructively and hold your own in senior conversations
  * Strong communication and relationship-building skills

This role will suit someone confident and resilient who enjoys taking ownership and is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with strong personalities and high expectations.  
  
**Why consider it?**  
  
This is an opportunity to join a profitable, well-established business that has grown strongly and is entering an interesting period of change and development.  
  
The initial 6–12 month interim assignment offers the chance to make an immediate impact, with the possibility of a permanent role for the right person if both sides want to continue the relationship.  
  
The company also offers:  


  * Hybrid working
  * 26 days’ holiday + bank holidays, plus your birthday off
  * Healthcare and wellbeing package, including remote GP and mental health support
  * Death in Service and company sick pay
  * Enhanced family-friendly policies

The requirement is immediate, so candidates who are available now or at short notice are particularly encouraged to apply.

Role Responsibilities

As Legal Cashier, you will support the firm's day-to-day financial operations and help maintain duties within this job will include:

  * Recording client and office account transactions accurately and in line with the SRA Accounts Rules.

  * Overseeing accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.

  * Proven experience of client account management, reconciliations and month-end closing.

  * Strong organisational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

  * Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

  * Salary sacrifice pension scheme.
  * Discretionary annual bonus.

Our client is a law firm with an international presence and a Manchester-based team. This Legal Cashier position offers the opportunity to work closely with colleagues locally while also liaising with an international head office as part of the wider finance function.

## Full job description

**Corporate Tax Manager – Advisory**

**£60,000–£70,000**

**OTE £90,000 - £100,000**

**Fully Remote**

  


Our client is a high-growth tax and strategic advisory firm supporting entrepreneurs, privately owned businesses and ambitious companies across the UK and internationally.

  


The firm has grown significantly in recent years by combining high-level technical expertise with a modern, commercially focused approach to corporate tax advice.

  


As the business continues to scale, this is a key senior appointment for an experienced corporate tax professional who wants greater influence, genuine autonomy and the opportunity to help shape the future of an advisory-led tax function.

  


This is not a traditional, compliance-heavy accountancy practice. You will be joining an ambitious, founder-led advisory business with a high-calibre client base, a strong market profile and clear plans for continued growth.

  


**The Role**

  


You will work closely with the senior leadership team, taking responsibility for complex corporate tax advisory projects while helping to develop the firm’s wider corporate tax offering.

  


The client base includes founder-led businesses, owner-managed companies, scaling organisations and established privately owned groups. These are clients who require proactive, commercially intelligent advice rather than routine compliance support.

  


Many are growing rapidly, restructuring their operations, preparing for investment or sale, completing acquisitions, expanding internationally or dealing with increasingly complex corporate tax matters.

  


You will lead advisory projects, manage senior client relationships and provide clear, technically robust advice that considers both the immediate tax position and the client’s wider commercial objectives.

  


**Typical responsibilities will include:**

  


  * Leading complex corporate tax advisory engagements for owner-managed businesses, privately owned groups and entrepreneurial companies
  * Advising on corporate restructures, reorganisations, demergers and group simplification projects
  * Supporting clients through acquisitions, disposals, investments and other corporate transactions
  * Advising on tax-efficient growth strategies, succession planning and business exits
  * Providing advice on corporation tax matters, capital allowances, loss utilisation and group relief
  * Supporting businesses expanding or operating internationally
  * Identifying and advising on relevant tax reliefs and incentives
  * Acting as a trusted corporate tax adviser to business owners, directors and senior leadership teams
  * Reviewing technical work and helping to develop less experienced members of the tax team
  * Working with senior leadership to shape and grow the corporate tax advisory function
  * Identifying opportunities to improve technical standards, service delivery and client outcomes



  


**Why This Opportunity Stands Out**

  


This role offers access to the quality of work, client complexity and technical challenge often associated with larger firms, but within a more agile, entrepreneurial and genuinely influential environment.

  


You will not be one of many senior tax professionals within a large corporate structure. You will be a central figure in the firm’s next phase of growth, with visibility across the business and the opportunity to help build a corporate tax function of long-term value.

  


The firm has achieved significant year-on-year growth and continues to attract increasingly complex advisory projects. There is a clear strategy for the future, continued investment in technology and infrastructure, and a strong appetite to keep raising standards across the business.

  


For the right person, there is also the potential to benefit from extensive bonus incentives and longer-term equity participation.

  


**Your Profile**

  


This is a senior appointment, so it is essential that you already have a proven background in corporate tax advisory.

  


Ideally, you will have:

  


  * CTA, ACA, ACCA or CA qualification
  * Strong experience within corporate tax advisory
  * Experience advising owner-managed businesses, privately owned groups or entrepreneurial companies
  * The ability to lead complex advisory conversations and explain technical matters clearly
  * Experience advising on corporate restructures, transactions, reorganisations or business disposals
  * Strong technical knowledge and the ability to apply tax legislation within commercial scenarios
  * Experience reviewing complex corporate tax work
  * International tax exposure would be advantageous
  * The confidence to work closely with business owners, directors and senior stakeholders
  * An interest in helping to develop and grow a corporate tax advisory function



  


This role would suit an experienced Senior Corporate Tax Manager, Corporate Tax Manager or Senior Corporate Tax Advisor who wants to move into a more entrepreneurial, advisory-led environment offering genuine influence and long-term opportunity.

  


For further information or a confidential discussion, please get in touch.

## Full job description

**International Tax Manager**

**£60,000–£70,000 plus bonus**

**OTE £90,000 - £100,000**

**Fully Remote**

  


Our client is a fast-growing tax and strategic advisory firm supporting entrepreneurs, privately owned businesses and international groups across the UK and overseas.

  


The firm advises clients whose operations, investments and ownership structures increasingly span multiple jurisdictions. As the business continues to grow, it is looking to appoint an International Tax Manager who can lead complex cross-border advisory work and help shape the future development of its international tax offering.

  


This is a senior, client-facing role for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with a practical and commercial approach.

  


You will work directly with business owners, finance leaders and senior decision-makers, helping them understand the tax implications of operating, investing and expanding internationally.

  


**The Opportunity**

  


The role will involve advising UK businesses expanding overseas, international companies establishing a UK presence, privately owned groups with cross-border interests and entrepreneurs with increasingly complex international affairs.

  


Assignments may arise from international expansion, overseas investment, group restructuring, acquisitions, disposals, financing arrangements or changes to the way a business operates across different countries.

  


You will lead projects from initial scoping through to delivery, coordinating with overseas advisers where required and ensuring clients receive clear, joined-up advice.

  


Rather than operating within a narrowly defined international tax team, you will have broad exposure across corporate, transaction and owner-managed business matters.

  


**What You’ll Be Advising On**

  


Your responsibilities will include:

  


  * Advising UK businesses expanding into overseas markets
  * Supporting international groups establishing or growing their operations in the UK
  * Advising on cross-border corporate structures and international reorganisations
  * Reviewing the tax implications of overseas subsidiaries, branches and permanent establishments
  * Advising on double tax treaties and the availability of treaty relief
  * Supporting clients with withholding tax considerations
  * Advising on the UK tax treatment of cross-border payments, financing and investment
  * Providing guidance on controlled foreign company rules and other anti-avoidance provisions
  * Advising on corporate residence and permanent establishment risk
  * Supporting international acquisitions, disposals and wider transactions
  * Working with overseas tax advisers to coordinate advice across multiple jurisdictions
  * Identifying tax risks and planning opportunities within international business structures
  * Explaining complex international tax matters clearly to business owners and senior stakeholders
  * Reviewing technical work and maintaining consistently high standards
  * Supporting the development of junior colleagues
  * Helping senior leadership develop and grow the firm’s international tax proposition



  


**A Commercial Approach to International Tax**

  


The clients are not looking for theoretical advice delivered in isolation.

  


They need someone who can understand their commercial objectives, identify the issues that genuinely matter and provide practical recommendations that can be implemented.

  


You may be advising a founder-led company preparing to enter a new territory, an overseas business establishing a UK operation or an established group reviewing whether its current structure remains appropriate.

  


The work will regularly overlap with corporate tax, M&A, restructuring and private client matters, providing exposure to a broad range of complex advisory projects.

  


**Why This Role Stands Out**

  


This is an opportunity to undertake high-quality international tax work without becoming restricted to one narrow technical area.

  


You will have genuine ownership of assignments, direct access to senior decision-makers and the ability to influence how the international tax function develops as the firm continues to scale.

  


The business has achieved significant year-on-year growth and continues to invest in its people, technology and infrastructure.

  


It offers the technical challenge and client complexity commonly associated with larger firms, combined with the autonomy, pace and visibility of a founder-led advisory business.

For the right person, the package may also include substantial performance-related bonus incentives and the potential for longer-term equity participation.

  


**Your Background**

  


You will already have a strong grounding in international corporate tax and experience advising businesses on cross-border matters.

  


Ideally, you will have:

  


  * CTA, ACA, ACCA, CA or an equivalent professional qualification
  * Strong experience within international or corporate tax advisory
  * Experience advising UK businesses with overseas operations or international groups operating in the UK
  * Knowledge of double tax treaties, withholding taxes and permanent establishment matters
  * Experience advising on cross-border structures, reorganisations or transactions
  * An understanding of corporate residence, controlled foreign companies and international anti-avoidance rules
  * The ability to identify both technical risk and commercial opportunity
  * Confidence managing complex advisory projects and senior client relationships
  * The ability to explain technical matters clearly to non-tax specialists
  * Strong project-management and stakeholder-management skills
  * Experience reviewing work and supporting the development of junior colleagues
  * Broader exposure to transaction tax, transfer pricing or owner-managed businesses would be advantageous



  


Applications are welcomed from established International Tax Managers, as well as ambitious Assistant Managers or experienced Corporate Tax Advisors with strong international exposure who are ready to take the next step.

  


For further information or a confidential discussion, please get in touch.

  * Building relationships with new clients and helping grow your own network.

  * Playing an active role in shaping the continued growth of the Manchester tax team.

This is a role for someone who **enjoys working with people as much as they enjoy working with tax**.

You'll work closely with ambitious business owners, entrepreneurs, shareholders and privately owned groups, getting under the skin of their businesses and understanding what they're trying to achieve.

The work will span areas such as:

**Corporate Tax | Tax Planning | M &A | Restructuring | Succession Planning | Business Sales | Shareholder Tax | Group Reorganisations | CGT | Remuneration Planning**

Most importantly, we're looking for someone with **commercial curiosity** \- someone who wants to understand a client's ambitions and find the right tax solution, rather than simply tell them what the legislation says.

**Influence. Autonomy. Opportunity.**

You'll have the chance to join an established practice while still having the freedom to make your mark.

You'll be given the platform to:

  * Build and develop your own client relationships.
  * Work with ambitious OMBs and entrepreneurs.
  * Grow your own network and generate new opportunities.
  * Develop the Manchester tax offering.
  * Work alongside experienced professionals across the wider practice.
  * Develop and mentor a growing team.
  * Progress your career within a firm that values commercial thinking and client relationships.

**£80,000 - £100,000** , depending on experience, plus a competitive benefits package.

If you're an experienced tax professional who enjoys **working with entrepreneurs, advising business owners and winning work** , we'd love to hear from you.

This is an opportunity to step into a senior Manchester role where your **technical expertise, commercial instinct and relationships can genuinely make a difference**.

  * Payroll administration experience

  * Experience supporting month-end processes
  * Good Excel, Word and Outlook skills
  * Excellent accuracy and attention to detail
  * Strong organisational and time-management skills
  * Confidence working with figures and confidential information
  * The ability to manage your own workload
  * A positive, reliable and hands-on approach
  * Strong communication and relationship-building skills



**Desirable Experience**

  * CIPD Level 3 or above
  * HR administration experience
  * Experience supporting recruitment, onboarding or employee records
  * ISO, compliance or audit experience
  * Experience using QuickBooks, Xero or Sage
  * Experience working within a growing business



**Join Re-Com**

We are looking for someone who communicates professionally, works collaboratively and takes pride in delivering accurate and reliable work.

If you are an experienced finance professional looking for a varied role where your contribution will be valued, apply today.

**Tax Advisory Manager**

**Fully Remote**

**£65,000–£75,000 per year plus bonus**

**Job Description**

Our client is an award-winning, high-growth tax and strategic advisory firm working with entrepreneurs, privately owned businesses, high-net-worth individuals and ambitious companies across the UK and internationally.

**This is a fully remote UK-based role focused on tax advisory, not compliance.**

The firm has built a strong reputation for combining technically robust tax advice with a highly commercial, entrepreneurial approach. Its leadership is well respected within the market, and the business continues to attract increasingly sophisticated clients, projects and professional partnerships.

Tax sits at the heart of a broader advisory proposition, supporting founders and business owners through growth, restructuring, investment, transactions, wealth planning and major commercial decisions.

**The Bigger Picture**

Alongside its established tax capability, the firm now provides Strategic Business Advisory, working directly with founders to understand what they ultimately want to achieve and helping them build the business required to get there.

That could include preparing for a future sale, increasing enterprise value, securing investment, improving profitability or developing the infrastructure needed for further growth.

Tax therefore forms part of a much wider commercial relationship with clients rather than operating as an isolated technical service.

Over time, the wider business also intends to expand into complementary areas including **Corporate Finance and Debt Advisory**.

The scale of the opportunity is already significant.

The senior team is currently involved in multiple live deals involving privately owned businesses with turnover ranging from approximately **£10m to £60m**.

The firm is also developing strategic relationships with established professional-services organisations, including a wealth management business responsible for approximately **£4bn of client assets**.

Alongside this, the business is currently delivering an international programme of highly exclusive advisory events attracting prominent speakers, entrepreneurs and ultra-high-net-worth attendees with combined wealth exceeding **£1bn**.

**The Role**

You will work closely with the senior leadership team, taking responsibility for complex tax advisory work while contributing to the continued development of the tax function.

Clients include founder-led businesses, scaling companies, entrepreneurs and private clients with significant wealth.

Many are growing, restructuring, expanding internationally, preparing for investment, completing transactions or considering future exits.

You will provide technically strong, commercially relevant advice across corporate and private client tax matters.

Typical responsibilities will include:

  * Leading complex tax advisory engagements
  * Advising entrepreneurs, owner-managed businesses and high-net-worth individuals
  * Supporting clients through restructuring, growth, succession, investment, transactions and international expansion
  * Advising across corporate tax, private client tax and wider strategic tax planning
  * Working directly with founders around significant commercial and wealth-creation events
  * Applying tax legislation to complex commercial situations
  * Managing senior client relationships
  * Reviewing technical work and supporting the development of the wider tax team
  * Contributing to the evolution of the firm’s wider advisory proposition



**Why This Opportunity Stands Out**

This role offers the quality of clients, complexity of work and commercial exposure often associated with much larger firms, but within a more agile and entrepreneurial environment.

You will be joining during a significant period of growth rather than stepping into a rigid, established structure.

The business is ambitious, fast-moving and prepared to invest, with increasing exposure to transactions, strategic advisory work, private wealth and sophisticated founder-led businesses.

The role is also **fully remote** , providing genuine flexibility without sacrificing access to complex work, senior decision-makers or high-calibre clients.

For someone who enjoys technical tax but also wants to understand the wider commercial story behind a client’s business, this is an unusually broad opportunity.

For the right person, there is also the potential for **significant bonus incentives and longer-term equity participation**.

**Your Profile**

This role is aimed at someone operating at **Tax Assistant Manager or Tax Manager level** , or a strong Senior Tax Advisor ready to step up.

You must already have a proven background in tax advisory.

We are not accepting applications from candidates currently based outside the UK.

Ideally, you will have:

  * CTA, ACA, ACCA or CA qualification
  * A strong background in corporate and/or private client tax advisory
  * Experience contributing to or leading complex advisory work
  * The confidence to advise entrepreneurs, owner-managed businesses and high-net-worth individuals
  * Strong technical knowledge with the ability to apply tax legislation commercially
  * Strong commercial awareness
  * Exposure to restructuring, transactions, succession, investment or international tax would be advantageous



**This is not a compliance-focused tax role.**

It would suit a Tax Assistant Manager or Tax Manager who wants to join an ambitious, entrepreneurial advisory business offering genuine influence, high-calibre work, flexibility and significant long-term upside.

For more information or a confidential discussion, please get in touch.

**Tax Advisory Manager**

**Fully Remote**

**£65,000–£75,000 per year plus bonus**

**Job Description**

Our client is an award-winning, high-growth tax and strategic advisory firm working with entrepreneurs, privately owned businesses, high-net-worth individuals and ambitious companies across the UK and internationally.

**This is a fully remote UK-based role focused on tax advisory, not compliance.**

The firm has built a strong reputation for combining technically robust tax advice with a highly commercial, entrepreneurial approach. Its leadership is well respected within the market, and the business continues to attract increasingly sophisticated clients, projects and professional partnerships.

Tax sits at the heart of a broader advisory proposition, supporting founders and business owners through growth, restructuring, investment, transactions, wealth planning and major commercial decisions.

**The Bigger Picture**

Alongside its established tax capability, the firm now provides Strategic Business Advisory, working directly with founders to understand what they ultimately want to achieve and helping them build the business required to get there.

That could include preparing for a future sale, increasing enterprise value, securing investment, improving profitability or developing the infrastructure needed for further growth.

Tax therefore forms part of a much wider commercial relationship with clients rather than operating as an isolated technical service.

Over time, the wider business also intends to expand into complementary areas including **Corporate Finance and Debt Advisory**.

The scale of the opportunity is already significant.

The senior team is currently involved in multiple live deals involving privately owned businesses with turnover ranging from approximately **£10m to £60m**.

The firm is also developing strategic relationships with established professional-services organisations, including a wealth management business responsible for approximately **£4bn of client assets**.

Alongside this, the business is currently delivering an international programme of highly exclusive advisory events attracting prominent speakers, entrepreneurs and ultra-high-net-worth attendees with combined wealth exceeding **£1bn**.

**The Role**

You will work closely with the senior leadership team, taking responsibility for complex tax advisory work while contributing to the continued development of the tax function.

Clients include founder-led businesses, scaling companies, entrepreneurs and private clients with significant wealth.

Many are growing, restructuring, expanding internationally, preparing for investment, completing transactions or considering future exits.

You will provide technically strong, commercially relevant advice across corporate and private client tax matters.

Typical responsibilities will include:

  * Leading complex tax advisory engagements
  * Advising entrepreneurs, owner-managed businesses and high-net-worth individuals
  * Supporting clients through restructuring, growth, succession, investment, transactions and international expansion
  * Advising across corporate tax, private client tax and wider strategic tax planning
  * Working directly with founders around significant commercial and wealth-creation events
  * Applying tax legislation to complex commercial situations
  * Managing senior client relationships
  * Reviewing technical work and supporting the development of the wider tax team
  * Contributing to the evolution of the firm’s wider advisory proposition



**Why This Opportunity Stands Out**

This role offers the quality of clients, complexity of work and commercial exposure often associated with much larger firms, but within a more agile and entrepreneurial environment.

You will be joining during a significant period of growth rather than stepping into a rigid, established structure.

The business is ambitious, fast-moving and prepared to invest, with increasing exposure to transactions, strategic advisory work, private wealth and sophisticated founder-led businesses.

The role is also **fully remote** , providing genuine flexibility without sacrificing access to complex work, senior decision-makers or high-calibre clients.

For someone who enjoys technical tax but also wants to understand the wider commercial story behind a client’s business, this is an unusually broad opportunity.

For the right person, there is also the potential for **significant bonus incentives and longer-term equity participation**.

**Your Profile**

This role is aimed at someone operating at **Tax Assistant Manager or Tax Manager level** , or a strong Senior Tax Advisor ready to step up.

You must already have a proven background in tax advisory.

We are not accepting applications from candidates currently based outside the UK.

Ideally, you will have:

  * CTA, ACA, ACCA or CA qualification
  * A strong background in corporate and/or private client tax advisory
  * Experience contributing to or leading complex advisory work
  * The confidence to advise entrepreneurs, owner-managed businesses and high-net-worth individuals
  * Strong technical knowledge with the ability to apply tax legislation commercially
  * Strong commercial awareness
  * Exposure to restructuring, transactions, succession, investment or international tax would be advantageous



**This is not a compliance-focused tax role.**

It would suit a Tax Assistant Manager or Tax Manager who wants to join an ambitious, entrepreneurial advisory business offering genuine influence, high-calibre work, flexibility and significant long-term upside.

For more information or a confidential discussion, please get in touch.

**£30,000–£60,000 depending on experience | Hybrid, part-time and condensed hours considered**

An excellent opportunity has arisen to join the expanding tax team of a well-established independent accountancy practice in Wilmslow.

The firm has experienced significant growth in recent years and continues to invest in its people, technology and specialist tax services. It supports an interesting private-client portfolio including professionals, business owners, property investors and high-net-worth individuals.

The role can be tailored around the successful candidate’s experience. Applications are welcomed from experienced Personal Tax Assistants and Seniors through to established Managers seeking greater responsibility.

Experienced staff can work predominantly from home, while part-time and condensed working arrangements will also be considered.

**Duties and responsibilities**  
**  
**

You will initially receive a manageable portfolio, giving you time to understand the clients, systems and working practices before gradually taking on greater responsibility.

Your duties may include:

  * Preparing personal tax returns and supporting calculations.
  * Managing a portfolio of private clients and building long-term relationships.
  * Obtaining information from clients and resolving queries.
  * Ensuring work is completed accurately and in line with HMRC deadlines.
  * Preparing files for review and Partner sign-off.
  * Responding to HMRC correspondence and client enquiries.
  * Identifying issues that may require further tax advice.
  * Working closely with colleagues across tax, accounts and payroll.
  * Supporting junior colleagues, depending on your experience.
  * Contributing to process improvements and internal projects.



There will also be opportunities to develop broader advisory experience in areas such as:

  * Capital gains tax.
  * Inheritance tax planning.
  * Trusts.
  * Property portfolios.
  * Overseas tax matters.
  * Tax planning for high-net-worth individuals and business owners.



The firm encourages employees to become involved in technical, technology and process-improvement projects alongside their client work.

**Experience and qualifications**  
**  
**

The firm is flexible on the level of appointment and will consider candidates with different levels of experience.

You will ideally have:

  * At least two years’ personal tax experience.
  * Experience preparing UK personal tax returns.
  * A good understanding of UK personal tax compliance.
  * Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
  * Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  * A client-focused and collaborative approach.
  * The confidence to ask questions and seek support when required.
  * An interest in developing your technical knowledge and wider advisory experience.



Candidates may be ATT qualified, studying towards ATT or qualified by experience. Study support can be provided for relevant ATT or CTA qualifications.

The firm is also interested in transferable skills gained outside tax, particularly experience involving customer service, communication, technology, languages, team leadership or process improvement.

**Benefits**  
**  
**

  * Salary of**£30,000–£60,000** , depending on experience.
  * Flexible and hybrid working.
  * Predominantly remote working available for experienced staff.
  * Part-time hours considered.
  * Condensed working patterns considered.
  * ATT or CTA study support.
  * Supportive buddy system.
  * Regular company-funded social events.
  * Exposure to complex private-client and advisory work.
  * Opportunities to lead internal and technical projects.
  * Genuine scope for progression as the tax team continues to grow.

**Company culture**  


The firm has a highly supportive and team-oriented culture. Colleagues work together during busy periods and employees are encouraged to ask questions, share ideas and contribute to the development of the business.

A buddy system ensures that employees always have more than one person available for support. The firm believes that admitting when you do not know something is a learning opportunity rather than a weakness.

Employees at all levels are encouraged to take ownership of projects and improve the way the firm works. This has included technical initiatives, technology implementation, workflow improvements and external presentations.

The practice combines interesting and technically varied work with the flexibility, close relationships and supportive culture of an independent firm.

**Interim Corporate Tax Accountant**

**Who we are**

At Grant Thornton we’re building something bold. We’re doing things differently - looking to the future, driving ambitious growth and pioneering positive change in our industry. Providing audit, tax and advisory services, we empower clients through strategic insight, curiosity, and genuine partnership. And we empower our people with real opportunity. Our journey from great to exceptional is well underway. With significant investment behind us and a clear strategy for growth, there’s real momentum.

Our **Agile Talent Community (ATC)** brings together experienced contract professionals who want choice without losing connection. You work where you add the most value, alongside teams who treat you as a partner rather than a placeholder. 

**Joining us in Tax**

The Corporate tax team at Grant Thornton provides expert advice on a wide range of tax matters, supporting clients with compliance, risk management, and strategic planning. Their services include corporate tax compliance, transaction support, structuring, and advice on tax-efficient growth and international expansion. The team works closely with businesses of all sizes to help them navigate complex tax legislation and optimize their tax position, ensuring they remain compliant while maximizing value.

If you’re an experienced **interim Corporate Tax Manager** who’s tired of choosing between freedom and meaningful work, there’s another route. Within our Tax team, you’ll be given the opportunity to take on short- to medium-term projects that sharpen your expertise, stretch your thinking, and give you a different angle on familiar challenges - all without locking you into a single path.

As a Corporate Tax Manager, you will play a pivotal role in providing expert guidance and leadership in all aspects of corporate tax compliance and advisory services. You will work closely with a range of clients, across avariety of industries, providing comprehensive tax solutions and strategic insights. This is an exciting opportunity for a tax professional to make a significant impact and contribute to our clients’ teams.

You can engage with us through your own limited company or on inside IR35 terms - whichever way gives you the freedom you’re looking for.

**Skills we are looking for**

  * Able to demonstrate knowledge within corporate tax compliance and advisory
  * Advising on a wide range of corporate tax matters, including tax planning, VAT, reorganisations, and M&A transactions
  * Overseeing and reviewing tax computations, tax returns, and tax accounting for clients
  * Identifying opportunities for tax efficiency and risk mitigation within client businesses
  * Building and maintaining strong client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor on tax matters
  * Keeping abreast of tax legislation changes and proactively communicating their impact to stakeholders
  * Professional qualification (CTA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent) required
  * Strong technical knowledge of corporate tax legislation and regulations
  * Proven experience in managing and developing client relationships
  * Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor and develop junior team members



  


**Why Consultants choose the ATC**

  * **Work that moves you forward**
  * When a project fits your skills, we’ll get in touch, but you choose whether it’s right for you. That means working on engagements that genuinely build your portfolio and expand your expertise. 
  * **The freedom of contracting without the hidden admin**
  * You’re not left to navigate the freelance world alone. Our Agile Talent team helps you understand freelance regulation and connects you with people who broaden your thinking through our teams and clients. 
  * **Community you can actually feel**
  * Connection shouldn’t disappear just because you’re contracting. From market insights to wellbeing sessions to networking events, you’ll be part of a community designed to make the independent path less isolated and more impactful.



**Our culture and values**

We have a culture where talented people thrive – where high performance is not just expected but enabled. It’s a culture built on clarity, curiosity, and care. One that challenges us to aim higher, where we’re encouraged to make the most of an abundance of resources to fuel our own development, and where we support each other to grow, learn, and succeed. 

Our open and accessible culture means you’ll interact with leaders who are interested in you and everything you bring to our firm. The things that set you apart, we value them. That’s why we give you the freedom to bring your whole self to work and pursue your passions inside and outside of work

**How to join**

We keep the process straightforward, because the real work happens once you’re here.

  * Submit your CV and basic details through our online application.
  * If there’s a match, a recruiter will reach out to discuss. 
  * Meet key stakeholders for a focused conversation.
  * Complete your background checks, join the Agile Talent Community, and start exploring the opportunities we have to offer. 



If you need adjustments at any point in the process, please let us know during the application stage - we aim to make sure our roles are accessible to everyone.

At Grant Thornton we’re building something bold. We’re doing things differently - looking to the future, driving ambitious growth and pioneering positive change in our industry. Our **Agile Talent Community (ATC)** brings together experienced contract professionals who want choice without losing connection. You work where you add the most value, alongside teams who treat you as a partner rather than a placeholder.

The Corporate tax team at Grant Thornton provides expert advice on a wide range of tax matters, supporting clients with compliance, risk management, and strategic planning. Their services include corporate tax compliance, transaction support, structuring, and advice on tax-efficient growth and international expansion. The team works closely with businesses of all sizes to help them navigate complex tax legislation and optimize their tax position, ensuring they remain compliant while maximizing value.

If you’re an experienced **interim Corporate Tax Manager** who’s tired of choosing between freedom and meaningful work, there’s another route. Within our Tax team, you’ll be given the opportunity to take on short- to medium-term projects that sharpen your expertise, stretch your thinking, and give you a different angle on familiar challenges - all without locking you into a single path.

As a Corporate Tax Manager, you will play a pivotal role in providing expert guidance and leadership in all aspects of corporate tax compliance and advisory services. You will work closely with a range of clients, across avariety of industries, providing comprehensive tax solutions and strategic insights. This is an exciting opportunity for a tax professional to make a significant impact and contribute to our clients’ teams.

You can engage with us through your own limited company or on inside IR35 terms - whichever way gives you the freedom you’re looking for.

**Skills we are looking for**

  * Able to demonstrate knowledge within corporate tax compliance and advisory
  * Advising on a wide range of corporate tax matters, including tax planning, VAT, reorganisations, and M&A transactions
  * Overseeing and reviewing tax computations, tax returns, and tax accounting for clients
  * Identifying opportunities for tax efficiency and risk mitigation within client businesses
  * Building and maintaining strong client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor on tax matters
  * Keeping abreast of tax legislation changes and proactively communicating their impact to stakeholders
  * Professional qualification (CTA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent) required
  * Strong technical knowledge of corporate tax legislation and regulations
  * Proven experience in managing and developing client relationships
  * Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor and develop junior team members



  


**Why Consultants choose the ATC**

  * **Work that moves you forward**
  * When a project fits your skills, we’ll get in touch, but you choose whether it’s right for you. That means working on engagements that genuinely build your portfolio and expand your expertise. 
  * **The freedom of contracting without the hidden admin**
  * You’re not left to navigate the freelance world alone. Our Agile Talent team helps you understand freelance regulation and connects you with people who broaden your thinking through our teams and clients. 
  * **Community you can actually feel**
  * Connection shouldn’t disappear just because you’re contracting. From market insights to wellbeing sessions to networking events, you’ll be part of a community designed to make the independent path less isolated and more impactful.



**Our culture and values**

We have a culture where talented people thrive – where high performance is not just expected but enabled. It’s a culture built on clarity, curiosity, and care. One that challenges us to aim higher, where we’re encouraged to make the most of an abundance of resources to fuel our own development, and where we support each other to grow, learn, and succeed. 

Our open and accessible culture means you’ll interact with leaders who are interested in you and everything you bring to our firm. The things that set you apart, we value them. That’s why we give you the freedom to bring your whole self to work and pursue your passions inside and outside of work

**How to join**

We keep the process straightforward, because the real work happens once you’re here.

  * Submit your CV and basic details through our online application.
  * If there’s a match, a recruiter will reach out to discuss. 
  * Meet key stakeholders for a focused conversation.
  * Complete your background checks, join the Agile Talent Community, and start exploring the opportunities we have to offer. 



If you need adjustments at any point in the process, please let us know during the application stage - we aim to make sure our roles are accessible to everyone.
